Peter,

Over the last few weeks, Kim has been focused on reaching voters in every corner of Washington's 8th District. From knocking on doors to walking in parades and visiting local businesses, Kim's meeting with Washingtonians to hear about what's on their minds and share how she's fighting for them in Congress. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48411079/358148934/-382226269?refcode=em22_220728_eom4_fnd_gq_act___ts_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220728_eom4_fnd_gq_act___ts_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZjAwODk2OS0wYzBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SqmFNPslJhncUe904pPg7ApMPFdEo_5kYy2if7obqko=) Once the primary is over next week, we need to be ready to hit the ground running if we're going to defeat Kim's Republican opponent and defend our Democratic House majority – but it won't be easy. ### **Early Voting In Person has started in Wisconsin!
(click [here](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=6tHPUOz_QyJBsFbb3HDnJucOT4BHGFfyUv9dGI-kuOBrSS5COH7eejmwP6OI6WyDC7nzooGmDnQrt0wCHMgfSQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ic_halfed_1&n=2) to find your polling location)**
With the upcoming elections quickly approaching, we wanted to make sure you were aware of some recent victories and updates on Election Integrity:
* #### **DROP BOXES & BALLOT HARVESTING ARE RULED ILLEGAL. ** _[see below]_
* #### The number of voters who are registered as '**Indefinitely Confined** ' was cut down by 55% since November 2020.
* **JCRAR[ voted to suspend WEC rule](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VB47-dFNmBEqPXGQ3b087VAk0A-BTRqxPiwcDzz8j6madd7uTEMe1XIq8v7j52I2p7ZWU2kbuvaayo81BbD8mGMII0ENq3JB-zG8XYmV9LvIXCzqlIoowfV19SXY_eBzJ2IG3HZbhQf2kIFKV6rYDg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ic_halfed_1&n=3) on curing absentee ballot envelopes. **
* Republicans also filed a [**lawsuit in Waukesha County**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=FZeaJrGkqb-JdJpt5MxOBKS8Js0LRyvMe-odjJ5xqB4hiNdkOcYtiS-xgzlaGtqCdDfKMKWjsSPLtUd3jlT5LXiwi5vhjf_IA9abBXP36ZU&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ic_halfed_1&n=4) against WEC on the curing of ballots.

* **Kenosha and Ozaukee County were two of the latest counties to pass bans on private/outside money being allowed to impact our election system.**
* Walworth, Washington, Lafayette, Kewaunee, and Brown are the other counties who passed similar resolutions.

**These are victories voters can be proud of. We will continue to fight to ensure transparent and fair elections!**
* * *

The RNC has also launched a new website ([**wisconsin.protect thevote.com**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=FZeaJrGkqb-JdJpt5MxOBDLlC9Lji7nLMcCAYaZ6Wgol3TLW4WhD_aeKSXCXRa_R&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ic_halfed_1&n=5)) that enables election observers and volunteers to report any election irregularities they are seeing in real-time! | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=FZeaJrGkqb-JdJpt5MxOBDLlC9Lji7nLMcCAYaZ6Wgol3TLW4WhD_aeKSXCXRa_R&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ic_halfed_1&n=6 "Check out the new reporting website here!") ### **Finally, check out the email below for details on how you can help strengthen our election integrity efforts!**
**From:** Election Integrity Alerts <info@wisgop.org>
**Sent:** Monday, July 11, 2022 11:28 AM
**Subject:** Wisconsin's Supreme Court Ruling
Friend --
**In a major win for election integrity, the Wisconsin Supreme Court affirmed that ballot drop boxes and ballot harvesting are ILLEGAL.**
The WisGOP has long opposed these practices, as they go against the letter of the law, create opportunities for fraud, and undermine confidence in our elections. We even joined the RNC and NRSC in an [**amicus brief**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0R72aAQRdpUWAFwuxNARiAUGeOTbTLvhsakhPOaGLT5xjF6Ub_k46e1PxTPSGnCS5miClFFJZBJseoM49u8vE1k&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ic_halfed_1&n=8) in this case.
We’ve fought tooth-and-nail to make sure that our elections are run in accordance with the law. clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Derek, __I want to take a minute to talk about our progress... Since launching our conservative movement here in the Granite State during the middle of a snowstorm this past January, and announcing my run to bring the 603 to D.C. with a U.S. Senate campaign, I’ve been humbled by the outpouring of support from folks like YOU. I’m proud to announce that - through the contributions of over 1,400 different individuals, showing their support of whatever amount they can at a time through emails just like this one \- we’ve raised over $1.3 million for our campaign so far! I’m equally proud to announce that the same fiscally responsible leadership I’ve followed both as a small business owner and as State Senate President have been practiced on the campaign trail. We still have $1 MILLION in cash-on-hand, ready to be used for competing with Hassan’s Hollywood donors over this final stretch of the campaign! This is a testament to the hard work and dedication of supporters like YOU. YOU helped make this early success happen. But we need to keep it up if we want all of this enthusiasm to translate into a VICTORY over the radical, progressive Democrat agenda in November. | | | | | | | Remember for a minute what’s at stake... No matter what crisis we’re talking about - the supply chain, gas prices, groceries, baby formula, inflation, border \- Democrats like Hassan and Biden are to blame for every last one of them. The Washington political class is out-of-touch. Unlike them, I’m ready to stand up for small business owners, parents, veterans, and everyday Granite Staters. I hope you’ll help keep momentum high for that mission to stand up for the 603. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Thank you for the continued support - we’re off to a great start... Dear Patriot,
Below is an important sponsored message for
your consideration. Messages like these enable us to continue
bringing you the latest news at no cost.
Courtesy of Right Wing Report

It's been about 8 months since Sydney has
gotten more than 3 hours of sleep.

It's like the minute her head hits the
pillow, her mind starts racing at a million miles an hour.

And it doesn't matter what she's tried so
far.

Going on 6 mile walks.

Meditating before bed.

Keeping a thought journal next to her and
writing down what she thinks about as the night goes on.

Her brain just will not turn off!

None of her friends seem to understand what
it's like to never be able to sleep.

They all tell her things like, "just go to
bed earlier!"

Or "Have you tried melatonin? That really
works for me!"

As if she hasn't tried melatonin…

She's tried taking melatonin, benadryl,
tramadol muscle relaxers…

The only thing that seems to work is Ambien.

But she doesn't like the idea that she'll
never be able to sleep without them.

Plus when she does take them, she usually
wakes up feeling groggy and not well rested.

Which is a common problem with sleeping
pills.

Although they DO put you to sleep…

It's more like inducing an 8 hour coma than
it is the normal restful sleep you probably got in your 20's and
30's.

Obviously if the only way you can fall asleep
is sleeping pills, it's better than nothing.

But there are natural alternatives you can
use that may just work just as well.

Like the ingredient in this tea that nuns
used in the 1600's to knock-out their patients…

And is even still used today as a form of
natural anesthesia for surgery!

On the next page, find out why this natural
ingredient in this knock-out tea works as good as ambien WITHOUT
the side effects.

>> Don't drink this if you have to drive,
ONLY drink before you go to bed (will knock you out in 20
minutes)

name: David Trone
subject: Where do we go from here
disclaimer_text: Paid for by David Trone for Congress, Inc
body:
Peter,
The primary election is behind us, and we’re making plans for victory in November. But the truth is, there’s a lot of work to do before we get there. I wanted to bring you up to speed on what’s ahead — and ask for your help to get across the finish line.
You know just how important this year’s election is. It’s critical that we expand our majorities in the House and the Senate to continue our progress. Right here in the 6th District, we’ve got a fight on our hands. Republicans nominated an ultra-conservative Trump loyalist who still questions the results of President Biden’s election — and they’re going to pour millions of dollars into his campaign leading up to November. It’s our responsibility to keep him as far away from Capitol Hill as possible.
But our fight for progress isn’t just in Washington — it’s happening in Maryland as well. It’s time for us to unite behind our historic slate of Democratic candidates and elect Wes Moore as our next Governor alongside Anthony Brown, Brooke Lierman, and other Democrats on the ballot. Republicans have made it clear what they’ll do if they win. It’s our job to stop them and elect candidates who stand for our values.
Our number one priority is to vote in November. Democratic turnout during the primary election was low across the country — including here in Maryland. But if we’re going to win, we need to do more than cast our vote.
We need to mobilize and organize to get our message out there and encourage everyone in our community to make their voices heard. Right now, I’m building a team of field organizers and campaign staff to get this done. They’ll need your help. We want to have a list of supporters ready for the new team members so they can hit the ground running. Will you sign up to volunteer on my campaign? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pineFKnz00e0RW7YT1gBFQ2] Whether it’s just a few hours or a few days, you can truly make a difference.
If you’re not able to volunteer, there are other ways to show your support. You can put out a yard sign [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pineFKnz00e0RW7YT1gBFQ2] to show your neighbors who (and what) you stand for. And if you have the means, a donation to my campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/david_trone] would mean the world to me.
I’m confident that Democrats will win up and down the ballot in November. But it’s going to take all of us working together to get it done. Thank you for your support. We couldn’t have come this far without you.
Sincerely,
David

name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: I was warned
body:
Will you split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford before our critical fundraising deadline – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Franken]
Derek,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.
Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.
In order to be ready to fight back, we need to raise another $50,000 before our critical fundraising deadline, but right now, we’re still falling pretty short. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to have the resources we need to win, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give right now:
I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t important: Please, will you split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford before our critical fundraising deadline – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? subject: Get Ready for Battle
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=24ca16b8dfb2a3198f8ca08df0a53975fb5800d5ffad69ebe086a6ace5b95c3d101d9a59c8b18b1c161120bae0b142332ed4c9667acf96fa783cdaf7b31c056c266eb75c703e94f2012e10be62f9c566

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b18c632072c1f9c65b54fce7939e33ba5f27285517e0892b6824816e0acedb911d20808e988b99cd15dda0d90028e04a2cc7d1b675a44e47

Peter,

If the past two years have taught us anything, it’s that the Left will stop at nothing to control you. Fewer rights for you means more power for them, and that is exactly what they are after.

We saw it clear as day with blue state governors and their response to COVID: Shut everything down. Keep kids out of school. Keep businesses closed. Keep people masked.

In Florida, we did things differently.

We stood up against the corporate media, against bureaucrats like Fauci, and against Brandon himself. We kept the state of Florida open to protect people's jobs, to save businesses, and to Keep Florida Free.

I didn’t do this because there was something in it for me. I did it because it was the right thing to do. And that's what leadership is all about — doing what is right. Unfortunately, in today’s political environment, true leadership is hard to come by. But it is also needed now more than ever.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b18c632072c1f9c65b54fce7939e33ba5f27285517e0892b6824816e0acedb911d20808e988b99cd15dda0d90028e04a2cc7d1b675a44e47
[KEEP FLORIDA FREE]

I took an oath to serve this state because I wanted to do right by the people of Florida. I took that oath knowing that leadership is not cost-free. Knowing that when you step up to lead, you are absolutely going to face opposition. When you stand up, if you're willing to speak the truth, the Left will attack you, they will smear you, they will fight tooth and nail to take you down.

It's not just people like me who are leading a big state who have become the target of the Left’s attacks. It's a parent who may go to speak their mind at a school board meeting. It's a college student who may want to bring up conservative ideas on campus. If you are a threat to the Democrat Machine, they are going to come after you.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b18c632072c1f9c65b54fce7939e33ba5f27285517e0892b6824816e0acedb911d20808e988b99cd15dda0d90028e04a2cc7d1b675a44e47
[FIGHT BACK AGAINST THE DEMOCRAT MACHINE]

In times like these, we must stand our ground and fight even harder to protect our values and uphold our principles. It's not enough to just be right on the issues. We must actively fight back against the destruction Democrats are trying to achieve.

We cannot let the Left’s smear campaigns and blizzard of lies deter us from continuing to fight for what is right. We cannot allow them to knock us off course. I am not backing down one inch, and I need your help to make sure we stand up to the Left’s attacks. Whether we’re facing attacks from Brandon's agencies or a woke corporation, we will stand for what's right.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b18c632072c1f9c65b54fce7939e33ba5f27285517e0892b6824816e0acedb911d20808e988b99cd15dda0d90028e04a2cc7d1b675a44e47
[STAND FOR WHAT’S RIGHT]

When we look back on this time in history, I believe it will be remembered as the time when Florida fought back. When we finally said enough and rejected woke radicalism. When we came together to once again put people over politics.

It will not be easy. We will face opposition. The power-hungry Left will challenge us. Now is not the time to back down. Now is the time to get ready for battle, put on the full armor of God, and take a stand against the Left’s schemes.

We've accomplished a lot in the state of Florida over the past couple of years. But we have only begun to fight because we are on a mission to keep the state of Florida free and to save our great country.

We can’t win this fight without you.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b18c632072c1f9c65b54fce7939e33ba5f27285517e0892b6824816e0acedb911d20808e988b99cd15dda0d90028e04a2cc7d1b675a44e47
Are you with me?

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b18c632072c1f9c65b54fce7939e33ba5f27285517e0892b6824816e0acedb911d20808e988b99cd15dda0d90028e04a2cc7d1b675a44e47
[TAKE BACK OUR NATION]

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

clean_body: To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window. Peter, If the past two years have taught us anything, it’s that the Left will stop at nothing to control you. Fewer rights for you means more power for them, and that is exactly what they are after. We saw it clear as day with blue state governors and their response to COVID: Shut everything down. Keep kids out of school. Keep businesses closed. Keep people masked. In Florida, we did things differently. We stood up against the corporate media, against bureaucrats like Fauci, and against Brandon himself. We kept the state of Florida open to protect people's jobs, to save businesses, and to Keep Florida Free. I didn’t do this because there was something in it for me. I did it because it was the right thing to do. And that's what leadership is all about — doing what is right. Unfortunately, in today’s political environment, true leadership is hard to come by. But it is also needed now more than ever. [KEEP FLORIDA FREE] I took an oath to serve this state because I wanted to do right by the people of Florida. I took that oath knowing that leadership is not cost-free. Knowing that when you step up to lead, you are absolutely going to face opposition. When you stand up, if you're willing to speak the truth, the Left will attack you, they will smear you, they will fight tooth and nail to take you down. It's not just people like me who are leading a big state who have become the target of the Left’s attacks. It's a parent who may go to speak their mind at a school board meeting. It's a college student who may want to bring up conservative ideas on campus. If you are a threat to the Democrat Machine, they are going to come after you. [FIGHT BACK AGAINST THE DEMOCRAT MACHINE] In times like these, we must stand our ground and fight even harder to protect our values and uphold our principles. It's not enough to just be right on the issues. We must actively fight back against the destruction Democrats are trying to achieve. We cannot let the Left’s smear campaigns and blizzard of lies deter us from continuing to fight for what is right. We cannot allow them to knock us off course. I am not backing down one inch, and I need your help to make sure we stand up to the Left’s attacks. Whether we’re facing attacks from Brandon's agencies or a woke corporation, we will stand for what's right. [STAND FOR WHAT’S RIGHT] When we look back on this time in history, I believe it will be remembered as the time when Florida fought back. When we finally said enough and rejected woke radicalism. When we came together to once again put people over politics. It will not be easy. We will face opposition. The power-hungry Left will challenge us. Now is not the time to back down. Now is the time to get ready for battle, put on the full armor of God, and take a stand against the Left’s schemes. We've accomplished a lot in the state of Florida over the past couple of years. But we have only begun to fight because we are on a mission to keep the state of Florida free and to save our great country. We can’t win this fight without you. Are you with me? [TAKE BACK OUR NATION] Sincerely, Ron DeSantis MAKE A DONATION Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor.

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

| I hope you are enjoying your summer and staying cool. Despite the heat, Team Kildee has been out in our district knocking on doors and connecting with voters on the ground.

We’ve also ramped up our TV and digital advertising to get our message out across the district to reach voters.

From phone banks to canvassing and expanding our team on the ground, campaigning in our toss-up district doesn’t come cheap. **[That’s why we set a $14,000 goal by the end of the month to keep up our momentum. Will you help us reach it? Click here to chip in.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48427976/358227165/-1174604059?amount=22.87&contactdata=H0Gi%2BnMmOqVd6tM8n5xiCBLoAXVMz%2BG2OzVW%2BOQqGmqfS%2FYaB6XUSTl6ujbkEYS7HNXm6B2Eao60TfCO48VW4X3dlZ%2Fp0X8rm%2BNQ2dcfXeFXui6er1Wvc%2F%2FisYdUtSU8MBjkOUlhZsQLmnq4D4FHbA%3D%3D&refcode2=02382545-840e-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&refcode=DK_EM_FR_1MO_20220728_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjM4MjU0NS04NDBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cpYs7S2tdZmLHEbyQm2W9XBVrdkTvpQHEm4AoOTRHUE=)**

I won’t beat around the bush: we’re up against a lot this year.

Our race was officially labeled the “median” congressional district in America, meaning Michigan’s Eighth Congressional District is at the center of America’s politics. Exactly half of the country’s districts are more Democratic, and half are more Republican. **It’s a true toss-up seat. And with 435 congressional seats, it sits exactly in the middle—the 218th seat—that will determine control of Congress.**

And our opponents have taken notice. My opponent was just added to the National Republican “Young Guns” list, a top-tier designation meaning out-of-state special interests are ready to invest even more money into our race as they attempt to flip this seat.

Our opponent has also already written himself a check for $1.25 million (and counting), showing he’s willing to use his incredible wealth to try and buy this seat, despite not even owning a home in our community. _We need to show them that mid-Michigan is not for sale._

**But, thanks to continued grassroots support from folks like you, I’m able to stay focused on my work in Congress—including working to lower everyday costs on things like gas, groceries and prescription drugs.**

My constituents aren’t thinking about Republicans vs. Democrats or who had the best sound bite on the cable networks. Instead, my neighbors are worried about putting food on the table, paying rent, and raising their families. They reject partisan politics and don’t care what party you’re affiliated with. _**They just want their elected officials to work on the real pressing issues to improve their lives.**_

Exactly half of the country’s districts are more Democratic, and half are more Republican. It’s a true toss-up seat. And with 435 congressional seats, it sits exactly in the middle—the 218th seat—that will determine control of Congress. And our opponents have taken notice. My opponent was just added to the National Republican “Young Guns” list, a top-tier designation meaning out-of-state special interests are ready to invest even more money into our race as they attempt to flip this seat. Our opponent has also already written himself a check for $1.25 million (and counting), showing he’s willing to use his incredible wealth to try and buy this seat, despite not even owning a home in our community. We need to show them that mid-Michigan is not for sale. But, thanks to continued grassroots support from folks like you, I’m able to stay focused on my work in Congress—including working to lower everyday costs on things like gas, groceries and prescription drugs. My constituents aren’t thinking about Republicans vs. Democrats or who had the best sound bite on the cable networks. Instead, my neighbors are worried about putting food on the table, paying rent, and raising their families. They reject partisan politics and don’t care what party you’re affiliated with. body:
Running for office was never what I had planned.
| | |
---
Hi Peter,

It's Trudy again. I know you've gotten a lot of emails from my team and me over the last couple of days. But please, could you take just a moment to read this one? It is important.
You see, it wasn't an easy choice for me, deciding to run for Senate. **During this season of my life, I thought I would be giving back to my community through volunteer work and spending time with my loving husband, our kids, and our beautiful grandchildren.** Running for office was never what I had planned.
**But Peter, our country is headed in the wrong direction.** Division and extremism are pulling us apart at the seams. And while it's tempting to tune all of that out, I know that this work demands all of us. You see, the things happening in Washington will affect every state, every community, and every family.
**I knew that I had to do _something._**
So just as I stepped up to serve my state as a children's advocate, my community as a nurse, and my family as a widowed mom, I stepped up again.
And let me tell you, Peter, this campaign has been an unbelievably rewarding and inspiring experience. **I've met countless voters and had the unique privilege of listening to their stories, their ideas, and their hopes for the future.**
We've built an incredible grassroots team of people all across Missouri who are fired up and ready for the change we know is possible.**I know that this team has what it takes to win, but now, we need to prove it to the talking heads, the naysayers, and our opponents. **
**There's so much on the line this November.[So please, can I count on your $5 grassroots donation before 11:59 p.m. tonight? clean_body: Michael won his last midterm re-election by just 1.7%, and this race is going to be close. | = One month ago, the general election started when Joe O’Dea officially became Michael’s opponent. Here’s what we knew about him then: He was endorsed by the Colorado NRA and opposes new gun safety legislation that would keep Coloradans safe, He came out against Colorado’s law guaranteeing the right to choose, And he suggested cutting funding for critical safety nets like Social Security and Medicare. Here’s what we know about him now: He’s got the full support of the National GOP after Mitch McConnell announced he was “all-in in Colorado;” He donated half of his campaign’s fundraising for last quarter from his personal wealth because grassroots enthusiasm was low; He’s in favor of wasting taxpayer dollars to complete Trump’s wall. There’s a saying: when someone shows you who they are, believe them the first time. We know who Joe O’Dea is. He gave his own campaign seven-figures so he could buy his way onto the ballot and dumped cash into attack ads to try and win this seat. He’s out of step with Coloradans, and he’ll be a rubber stamp for Rick Scott — who wants to raise taxes on low-income folks and seniors — and Mitch McConnell— who could push a nationwide abortion ban. subject: Important update
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I am pleased and proud to announce that I have been endorsed by NARAL Pro-Choice America!
I am a long-time advocate for women's reproductive freedom, and the endorsement and support of NARAL is personally important to me. In Congress, I will fight to protect access to reproductive care and defend the right of women to choose and make their own healthcare and reproductive decisions. First, I need to win this election.
DONATE $25, $50, $100, $250 TO DEFEND THE RIGHT TO CHOOSE - CLICK HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
With the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , access to safe, legal abortions is at risk. In many states, it is already illegal, even if in cases of rape and incest, or when an abortion is medically necessary to save the life of the mother. Now, more than ever, we need to elect leaders who will stand up and fight for a woman's right to choose. I will fight to protect choice, and I will be an advocate for women's healthcare, but I can't do that without your help.
DONATE NOW TO SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN SO I CAN GO TO CONGRESS TO DEFEND REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM! - CLICK HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
NARAL is working hard to defend women's rights in the wake of the Supreme Court's decision. They have endorsed strong, pro-choice candidates around the country, and I am proud to be one of them.
In a statement announcing my endorsement, and the endorsement of two other strongly pro-choice candidates, NARAL Pro-Choice America President Mini Timmaraju released the following statement:
“Republicans want a nationwide ban on abortion, and the best way to stop them is
to elect candidates who will fight to protect and advance our freedom to decide if,
when, and how to start or grow a family. We are in the fight of our lives, and we
need leaders ready to be bold and unapologetic in their beliefs. The majority of
Americans—8 in 10—support the right to legal abortion. We must have a Congress
that reflects that.”
We are all in this fight together. If we are going to defend the rights of women to make their own healthcare decision, we need to stand-up now. None of us can afford to sit on the sidelines, and that is why I am asking for your support today!
DON'T SIT THIS ONE OUT! DONATE NOW TO SUPPORT OUR CAMPAIGN - CLICK HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/PaidForByDanielsForCongressB.jpg]
Daniels For Congress
2018 N. 3rd Street
Harrisburg, PA 17102

clean_body: We need to double down on our work to protect the vote and fight back: Fair Fight | | | There’s a lot on the line in this year’s midterm elections. With the stakes so high, no voter should be denied the opportunity to make their voice heard at the ballot box. Yet, after voters turned out in record numbers in 2020, anti-democratic politicians have doubled down on their suppressive tactics — primarily targeting voters of color and young voters — in order to hold onto their power this year. That means we need to double down on our work to protect the vote and fight back. So we’re excited to announce that Fair Fight Action has just received a $37,000 grant from CREDO Mobile, and we’re asking our community of supporters to double the impact by raising another $37,000 so that this support goes twice as far. = If you are feeling frustrated about continued efforts to undermine democracy, you are not alone. But the team at Fair Fight Action has remained strongly focused on breaking down barriers to voting across the nation and mitigating voter suppression. In preparation for the midterms, we have been working to stop extreme anti-voter legislation and expand voter protection programs in key states around the country — like Michigan and Georgia. The support we receive from emails like this one help make all of this possible. [**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd1c872lagbg2fa1c5gm0184pf03vna7fd6i8sdg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zbs1jguqvk5sg4nddipr2v5jbma0tfoe4mvoboio_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z9kls779fd0b070urjkm8ena4ucr1vb0g8rm6ck8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z0e79p8f3b9s0oavoulqkssul6us87dkgj6t9r2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zef9gmjdmr4l7ktlurlpre9khtir1ko06pfggb2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zuf6u7b434uabk59jab76nddudiru1ugngatusqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zlmsqtf08fa6bq6radgnsnscna78qhm8ojqs4oso_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something – this will be the most important race in the entire country – but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zj9lvnfalr565pnv63227srsbhe4otqg2ogtrd48_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zedjgnnnv118suc0cotb52e6fl7t16hoqv4aldsg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqhhtbromre5q8humaaj7d9jqo8vmdjnvnk7psgg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more – will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1u47o4atbe77qmvn68sqjknm2r4u4v061u6ohro_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhk25lgot82ma1cj93j6ugcefmt92eoqth62u598_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1h62p72cth2bs)

# Come meet Lt. Governor Winsome Sears and VA-08 Congressional Nominee Karina Lipsman on August 1st!
Peter,I was very proud to receive Governor Youngkin's endorsement last week, and I’m even more proud to announce that Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears is also backing my campaign to bring common sense back to Northern Virginia this November! Lieutenant Governor Sears will be joining me at an event on August 1st at 6:00pm. Details and more information can be found below. Save your spot today!
| [CLICK TO RSVP FOR THE EVENT TONIGHT!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=5421a023f6&e=22db41c18e)
---
[](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=583ae462e2&e=22db41c18e)
| [DONATE TODAY TO SUPPORT MY CAMPAIGN!](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=100eec779f&e=22db41c18e)
---
# Upcoming Events
Here is a list of what’s going on over the next few weeks! Save your spot today and come say hello!**July 30:** Alexandria Karina Farmers Market Tour! 9:00-10:00am at the Del Ray Farmer’s Market and 10:00-11:00am at the Old Town Farmer’s Market! No RSVP required, come say hello and meet your nominee!****August 1:** Lt. Gov. Winsome Sears guest hosts fundraiser for Karina Lipsman! VIP photo reception followed by general reception. $1,000 / $250 respectively. To attend, email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “Winsome Event.”** **August 4:** Falls Church Meet & Greet Happy Hour at the home of Rachel and Corey Neal! To attend, email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “August 4 Falls Church Meet and Greet.”***August 8:** Republican Party of Virginia (RPV) Chairman Rich Anderson hosts meet & greet fundraiser for the Southern Tier of VA08! Location and details pending. Email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “RPV Event” for details.* **August 11:** Latinos for Karina Happy Hour – 6:00-7:30pm at Los Chamacos, 922 South Walter Reed Drive, Arlington, VA 22204 – email [LatinosPorKarina@gmail.com](mailto:LatinosForKarina@gmail.com) to RSVP and receive more info on how to join the momentum!*****August 25:** First Lady of Virginia, Suzanne Youngkin to host special VIP fundraiser for Karina. Details pending. Email [RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com](mailto:RSVP@KarinaForCongress.com), subject “SY Event” for details.***
# THIS WEEK’S ENDORSEMENTS!
Governor Glenn Youngkin understands the importance of earning the support of voters across Northern Virginia. I’m honored to have his endorsement as we work to take our common sense principles to every community in Virginia’s 8th district.
I am very thankful to the folks at Rally Virginia for their endorsement of my campaign! I am so proud of the momentum our team is building with women-led grassroots organizations across Northern Virginia!
# KARINA AROUND TOWN
I met with former Congressman Will Hurd on Monday to discuss the importance of civility and bipartisanship to bring America back on track!
Check out the upcoming events above to see how you can join the momentum!
For common sense in Northern Virginia!Karina

subject: Answers to life’s persistent questions
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsQ6DTlhkN

Our "Introduction to Western Philosophy" course is now available
on DVD. And you can reserve your copy today.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osQ6DTlhkN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Our "Introduction to Western Philosophy"
course is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy
today.

Aristotle wrote: "All men by nature desire to
know."

The pursuit of knowledge about the most
important things has been the central activity of Hillsdale
College for over 175 years.

In contrast, most American colleges and
universities have embraced the "postmodern" idea that knowledge,
like truth, is relative-that there are no real answers to
questions like "What is the best kind of life?" and "What is the
right way to act?"

In 1931, Winston Churchill wrote an essay
where he imagined a future where mankind had secured a life of
great pleasure, wealth, and convenience. But, Churchill wondered,
would that be sufficient for happiness?

What did they know more than we know about
the answers to the simple questions which man has asked since the
earliest dawn of reason-'Why are we here? What is the purpose of
life? Whither are we going?'

No material progress, even though it takes
shapes we cannot now conceive, or however it may expand the
faculties of man, can bring comfort to his soul.

Hillsdale's free online course, "Introduction
to Western Philosophy," examines just such questions as Churchill
poses.

This course pursues answers to these
questions by studying the arguments of great Western philosophers
such as Plato, Aristotle, Thomas Aquinas, Immanuel Kant, and C.S.
Lewis.

And this 14-lecture course is now available
in a special DVD box set perfect for viewing in your home or a
small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool
curriculum or personal study.

The "Introduction to Western Philosophy" DVD
box-set can be yours with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more
to Hillsdale College. Reserve your copy today using this secure
link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-introduction-to-western-philosophy-dvd

Hillsdale produces and promotes free online
courses, as we do all of our work while refusing to accept
government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or
state student grants or loans.

With your tax-deductible gift today, we can
enroll thousands of Americans in "Introduction to Western
Philosophy" and other online courses on topics such as the
Constitution and American history.

Please help promote Hillsdale's free online
courses such as "Introduction to Western Philosophy" and other
educational outreach efforts in this critical time for America
with a tax-deductible gift.

And remember, when you give a gift of $100 or
more today, we'll send you a special DVD box set of "Introduction
to Western Philosophy" as our thank-you. Quantities are limited,
though, and you won't find this DVD anywhere else but from
Hillsdale.

You can make your tax-deductible gift in
support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts and receive
your DVD box set using this secure link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-introduction-to-western-philosophy-dvd

Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in
its educational mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

Doughty Dodges Debate on WRKO's "The Kuhner Report"
The Diehl for Governor campaign announced today that gubernatorial candidate Chris Doughty has failed to accept an invitation by the Diehl campaign for a second debate.
"Once both of our campaigns qualified for the ballot, I promptly invited Chris Doughty to participate in two debates," Geoff Diehl said. "Our first debate was on The Howie Carr Show. After that, Chris failed to accept my invitation for a second debate moderated by Jeff Kuhner. We're moving forward without him."
Diehl says he still plans to join Jeff Kuhner as an in-studio guest on August 11, the date originally reserved for the debate. "I keep my promises, and I look forward to discussing my campaign with Jeff Kuhner on-air," Diehl said. "The Kuhner Report is a well-recognized leading conservative show, which is probably why my opponent won't participate. He is most likely scared of defending his support for Hillary Clinton for President in 2016 and his lack of any record supporting the Republican Party."
Diehl's appearance on The Kuhner Report will be part of a high-profile week of events for his campaign. On Wednesday, August 10, Diehl will appear alongside South Dakota Governor Kristi Noem on the campaign trail in Boston. The two will headline a fundraiser at the home of Ernie Boch later that evening.
"We have so much to discuss, and I'm disappointed that Chris Doughty failed to accept my challenge for a debate," Diehl said. "Unfortunately, primary voters won't have a chance to hear me ask Chris Doughty directly why, when he sold the Tennessee company he referred to in our first debate, he was sued for allegedly fraudulently misrepresenting its value to its new owner. And they won't get to hear me ask Chris Doughty why so many legislators who endorsed him voted for the Biden-Healey climate change bill after our debate."
"Primaries are about letting voters decide who best can represent the party in the November election," Diehl said. "My campaign was supported by more than two-thirds of Republican activists at the party convention in May, and I believe Republican voters likewise will support me to be their candidate of choice to take on Maura Healey this fall."

| | | Peter,

My name is Amanda Adkins. I know you're busy, so I'll be short and to the point.

_**[1) I'm running in one of the most competitive House races in America, 2) Experts say this one race could determine who wins the House Majority, and 3) With respect, I am humbly asking you to make a ten-dollar contribution to my campaign before my August 2nd primary.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60890649:6dGfgTVN6:m:1:3317145305:962C2062435EC86FC92A8B0D59BF8FB1:r "1\) I’m running in one of the

asking you to make a ten-dollar contribution to my campaign before my August 2nd primary.")**_

My opponent is a die-hard Liberal Democrat who walks in lockstep with Nancy Pelosi, Joe Biden, and ALL their loyal followers.

I, on the other hand, am a no-nonsense conservative with a record of servant leadership. I was the chairwoman of the Kansas Republican Party, I served on the Board of The Salvation Army, I'm a mother of two, and a come-in-early-and-stay-late businesswoman. _I 'm also endorsed by Ted Cruz, Mike Pompeo, Kevin McCarthy, Nikki Haley, Elise Stefanik, and Steve Scalise. _

**I know I can win this race.**

If you don't believe me, just this month, RealClearPolitics UPGRADED my race from "Toss-Up" to "Lean Republican." That means the momentum is on our side. Republicans only need to gain four seats in the House to win back the Majority. **_[And this is one of the most competitive House races in the ENTIRE country, so I really need the support of Republicans in every corner of our country.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60890649:6dGfgTVN6:m:1:3317145305:962C2062435EC86FC92A8B0D59BF8FB1:r "And this is

I am supported by thousands of grassroots Republicans from across the country. And I'm proud of that. Those heroes who donate just a few bucks at a time are the backbone to my campaign, and they will be the reason we will win this race AND take back the House Majority.

body:
How our democracy remains a democracy
#
Peter,
I was in the Capitol on January 6th when violent insurrectionists tried to stop our democratic process with brute force. During the attack, I was locked in my office while the mob yelled and pounded on my door. I didn’t get to run away like Josh Hawley did — I was stuck in the Capitol.
January 6th will always be a dark day in our nation’s history — but it also instilled something in me that I will never forget:
_**Our democracy only remains a democracy because we fight for it.**_
So while the January 6th Committee continues its pursuit of truth and accountability for the insurrection — we all have a part to play in protecting our democracy.
We all have got to use our voice and our votes in November to reject Donald Trump's big lie — and his MAGA Republican supporters who continue to prop him and his dangerous lies up — and vote to protect our democracy now and in the future.
That is what is at stake in this election — and what I am fighting for.
Thank you,
Patty

**_As Washington's senior U.S. Senator, Patty Murray is working to help families, solve problems, and defend our progressive values._**

I will create a pro-life culture | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f29edc124ba0/encouraging-unity-in-advocacy-of-our-2nd-amendment-rights-8675229?e=0ee9ba69f7)

---
| | Peter,

Since the reversal of _Roe v. Wade_ , _one of the greatest Supreme Court decisions in America’s history_ , we have seen the Democrat party become unhinged.

What once was “safe, legal and rare” has now been replaced by “Abortion free and on demand up to birth.” **It is quite frankly, sickening. **

We have seen the Democrats attempt to use the issue of abortion _to avoid their disastrous record_ since Joe Biden assumed office in 2021. _They know they are failing._ They know the economy is in ruins, inflation is sky-rocketing, our borders are a national security threat and our global respect has been harmed through failed foreign policy.

**Joe Biden’s approval rating is in free-fall and people are abandoning the Democrat party everywhere.**

Now they are trying to fear-monger the American people by _using abortion as wedge issue_.

It is not going to work—the polls are in and **they spell disaster for Democrats come November. **
---
| [ ](https://lee4congress.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=154a22b8198eb2b6409601e45&id=8ae20ce8ab&e=0ee9ba69f7)
---
| The truth is, LIFE will always win. America has been expanding human rights since her inception. This will lead to the expansion of rights to the unborn. **This is what I will fight for in Congress. **

We need to be a country that promotes a culture of Life and Liberty, not Death and Decay. I will work to make this a reality.

The life of an unborn baby is just as precious and important as the life of the mother carrying it and the father who helped create it.

Abortion on demand sets a dangerous precedent that our ancestors will judge us harshly for. In a post-Roe world, _I choose the side of life_ and will vote for legislation that protects it.

Please join me as we fight for a better America!

_For Immediate Release:
July 28, 2022_

**Former Republican Secretary of the State Pauline Kezer Endorses Terrie Wood for Secretary of the State of Connecticut**

“This is a very important race for Secretary of the State. There is no incumbent, and it’s time to support the person most qualified to become the head of elections in this state. Terrie Wood is by far the most experienced, most competent, and most able person to fill this seat,” said Pauline Kezer.

Terrie Wood is currently serving her 7th term in the Connecticut House of Representatives where she has shown leadership and an ability to work in a bipartisan way to get things done. Secretary of the State is the third highest position in state government, and Terrie Wood is ready to step into this responsibility.

“There is not another candidate whose record, experience, and electability match what Terrie Wood has already achieved.”

The position of Secretary of the State has many facets, including securing our elections and managing important business functions for Corporations, (large and small), Limited Liability Companies and Sole Proprietors. Constantly improving and working with experts in their field is a critical skill which Terrie Wood possesses.

“This election, this year, it is imperative to put the 'most trustworthy' and genuine leader in the position of Secretary of the State. Peoples’ confidence in our electoral system needs to be restored. Terrie Wood is that person, and I hope all voters will take an interest in filling this position with the best candidate, Terrie Wood,” concluded Kezer.

The primary election is August 9th.

The general Election is November 8th.

_For further press inquiries[contact Pat O'Neil](mailto:patoneil2022@yahoo.com)._

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**BREAKING FL-13: Tampa Bay Times Editorial Board Endorses Kevin Hayslett for Congress**
_The Editorial Board described Hayslett as a strong conservative
who would bring a fact-based approach to governing_ **Clearwater, FL -** Today, the [Tampa Bay Times](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=f2aa2cbb41&e=c927abcf3e) announced their endorsement of Kevin Hayslett for Congress in Florida’s 13th Congressional District. In the crowded Republican field, the Editorial Board highlighted Kevin as “the candidate who best understands the district, its history, its people, and its challenges.” Two years ago, the Editorial Board endorsed Anna Paulina Luna over Amanda Makki, passing on both candidates this year in favor of Hayslett.

Last election cycle, Luna lost to Democrat Charlie Crist. In a year when Republicans gained 14 seats in the House, Luna proved she cannot win the FL-13 seat, and as the Editorial Board highlighted, she has an inability to lead and would sit behind other Republicans, as opposed to leading and fighting from the front.

In the case of Amanda Makki, the Editorial Board pointed to Makki’s work with Never-Trumper and RINO Lisa Murkowski. As well as Makki’s involvement with Big Pharma and working in the D.C. swamp as a lobbyist.

“Kevin Hayslett is an experienced lawyer with conservative views who would bring a commonsense, fact-based approach to governing,” stated the Tampa Bay Times Editorial Board. “He listed his three top priorities as combating rising inflation, cracking down on crime, and preserving personal freedoms.” The Editorial Board also stated “He would not support further restrictions on Second Amendment rights.”

The Editorial Board also pointed to the [abundance of support](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=e41bd0268f&e=c927abcf3e) Hayslett has received from local leaders, highlighting that Hayseltt is endorsed by Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd, and Florida Speaker of the House Chris Sprowls. Hayslett has also received endorsements from Citrus County Sheriff Mike Prendergast and retired Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats, further establishing himself as Law Enforcements choice for Congress.

In June, the [Tampa Free Press](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=beac54f590&e=c927abcf3e) Editorial Board announced their endorsement of Hayslett. With the endorsement of the Tampa Bay Times Editorial Board, Hayslett has now earned the endorsement of the two most circulated news publications in Pinellas County and the Tampa area.

“I entered this race as a political outsider because I know the kind of representation this community deserves. I’m ready to go to Washington and hold Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi accountable for the disastrous path they’ve put our county on,” stated Hayslett. “We have record inflation and our southern border is a disaster. Both of those things are directly impacting us here in Pinellas County. It’s time for a course correction, and it’s time to get our country back-on-track.” # # #

Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zosfcb3sc99r34a9bo3puk2vrjir91q2pqvf3i90_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68oj4cth2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3sb1nshra938oi2m7shnu5eo7ukismjhofbcm88_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68oj4cth2bs)

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5eaf4a4id8c74jqcoapgmcdu537b432corgfhb8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68oj4cth2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo8cl4bj7eq5q47iq7d4qa7aa6vhvqb5vhm0270g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68oj4cth2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zia45l3hfbubdgf2l6a73iendjdjlc6g52sph2j0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68oj4cth2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,

| [ ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7oontls7pa65sb7njcpp6ocuhfo37q3ptm019pg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68pj5cjh2bs)

---
Friend,

I’m Yesli Vega, and I’m running for Congress in Virginia’s 7th Congressional District.

I want to tell you about a crucial moment that changed my life forever.

I was leaving church with my family when I received the worst phone call of my life, that my brother had been gunned down by MS-13 gang members. That day I saw a friend lose his life and my brother severely wounded.

>From then on, my life would never be the same. I pledged to dedicate everything I had to protecting my community and my family by becoming a cop – making sure no family would ever endure the terror and grief that we experienced.

As a **deputy sheriff** , I put it all on the line for my community.

**Now, I see a new threat.**

We’re seeing our _**borders open**_ again, causing a humanitarian crisis. _**Wasteful spending**_ is driving up the cost of living to levels we haven’t seen in decades. _**Crime**_ is skyrocketing across the country due to the far-left’s dangerous Defund the Police agenda. _**Enough’s enough.**_

[**WATCH BELOW TO HEAR MORE ABOUT WHY I’M RUNNING TO REPRESENT YOU!**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf9r1l5u11ppr5hthog2eceii40btf9p3f6fjo50_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68pj5cjh2bs)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk959urn7usdvsh5bgkae8jafcon6cf2t7nl3img_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68pj5cjh2bs)
[**Join me in telling Congress and the career politicians their time is UP.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoha1lu8bolq912n63f7nq6d1ngmol9eo53ohq28_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68pj5cjh2bs)
When my parents fled war-torn El Salvador, they came to this country hoping for a better future. And in doing so, they gave me the opportunity to achieve the **American Dream**. >From the child of immigrants to military wife to Prince William County supervisor, _**I’ve always been a conservative fighter.**_

For far too long, we have watched _**Liberal politicians like Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and Abigail Spanberger**_ tear apart our communities with their divisive, anti-American Agenda.

[**WILL YOU HELP ME MAKE IT TO CONGRESS?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjg5s7mpgfgrgaasq05plsbn6llb9o3j96c0j8v0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1j68pj5cjh2bs)
**Join me in the fight. It’s now or never.**

God Bless,

clean_body: Biden nor Spanberger will stop the violence | Friend, I’m Yesli Vega, and I’m running for Congress in Virginia’s 7th Congressional District. I want to tell you about a crucial moment that changed my life forever. I was leaving church with my family when I received the worst phone call of my life, that my brother had been gunned down by MS-13 gang members. That day I saw a friend lose his life and my brother severely wounded. From then on, my life would never be the same. I pledged to dedicate everything I had to protecting my community and my family by becoming a cop – making sure no family would ever endure the terror and grief that we experienced. As a deputy sheriff , I put it all on the line for my community. Now, I see a new threat. We’re seeing our borders open again, causing a humanitarian crisis. Wasteful spending is driving up the cost of living to levels we haven’t seen in decades. Crime is skyrocketing across the country due to the far-left’s dangerous Defund the Police agenda. Enough’s enough. When my parents fled war-torn El Salvador, they came to this country hoping for a better future. And in doing so, they gave me the opportunity to achieve the American Dream. >From the child of immigrants to military wife to Prince William County supervisor, I’ve always been a conservative fighter. For far too long, we have watched Liberal politicians like Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and Abigail Spanberger tear apart our communities with their divisive, anti-American Agenda. Join me in the fight. It’s now or never. God Bless, Yesli Vega Official Republican Nominee Virginia's 7th Congressional District | | Military Wife. Mother. We're out having real conversations with real people — not corporate lobbyists or political insiders.
#

Friends -
We know you receive a good number of fundraising emails, so we felt we owed you an explanation of exactly where your contribution goes when you make it.
There are 515,227 registered voters in New York's new 17th district. 211,491 of them are Democrats, and another 136,454 have no official party registration at all.
We have only one plan for this campaign: **_Get Alessandra's message in front of as many of these people as possible, and turn them out to vote._**
It's a simple task, but not an easy one. Doing it right takes a LOT of resources. That's why we're asking:
[**Can you make a contribution — of $3 or anything you can — to our people-powered campaign before this weekend's end-of-month fundraising deadline? name: Val Demings (personal)
subject: it wasn't easy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good
| | |
---
Friend: Each and every day it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even when the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today.

We've had a busy past few months launching this campaign. And now, my primary election is just five days away. Some folks have their minds made up already, and others are still hearing out each of the candidates. But all of them are there to share their stories, voice their concerns, and talk about their vision for the future. Having the chance to listen to and understand my fellow Missourians has been the honor of a lifetime. I know that the past few months haven't been easy. It's hard to hold onto hope while watching MAGA extremists drum up support and push their hateful ideologies. It's hard to see a bright future through all the clouds. name: =?utf-8?Q?Russ=20Vought?=
subject: Our plan to crush the deep state
body:
A blueprint to save our country. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-8996339?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

We’ve been waiting to tell you about this for months.

As you know, CRA is one of the nation’s premier America First organizations dedicated to stopping the left’s destructive woke agenda.

What you may not know is the _comprehensive plans_ we’ve been crafting **to destroy the corrupt deep state**.

Today, I'm pleased to give you an inside peek at months of closed-door meetings and planning sessions culminating in a bold plan to ensure the America First agenda is put into place in a future administration.

It’s the _blueprint_ for saving our country, and it’s getting a lot of attention in the media.
---
|
---
| **The Blueprint: How to Crush the Deep State**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d6ec9df39b&e=17913c7d6d)
---

A recent [report](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=2aa4490375&e=17913c7d6d) in _Axios_ cited the Center for Renewing America as an “ _influential_ ” group that is “ _designed to keep alive and build upon Trump’s 'America First' agenda during his exile._ ”

_It’s true, but there’s so much more_.

As I told _Axios_ , **“ _we are consciously bringing on the toughest and most courageous fighters with the know-how and credibility to crush the deep state_.” **

The report went into further detail on our plan:

_"During the past year, Vought’s group has been developing plans that would benefit from Schedule F. And while the power rests largely on the fear factor to stifle civil service opposition to Trump, sources close to the former president said they still anticipate needing an alternate labor force of unprecedented scale — of perhaps as many as 10,000 vetted personnel — to give them the capacity to quickly replace ‘obstructionist; government officials with people committed to Trump and his "America First" agenda._

_In other words, a new army of political partisans planted throughout the federal bureaucracy.”_

For far too long GOP administrations have been staffed with career bureaucrats afraid to take on the deep state.

**This plan isn’t for the fainthearted.**

It can only be implemented by loyal America First patriots who care more about saving the country than getting invitations to cocktail parties by liberal elites.

The good news is, our team is working 24/7 to identify and activate America First activists and we have the trust and support of President Trump.
|
---
| **Trump’s Inner Circle: Center for Renewing America Cited as Top Ally**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=640e557703&e=17913c7d6d)
---
The _Axios_ report went on to [cite our critical work](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6f8feabd7b&e=17913c7d6d) and close relationship with President Trump.

“ _By this stage in the evening, more than a hundred people were crammed onto the Mar-a-Lago patio. They were a mix of wealthy political donors and allies of the former president and they had come to see Trump himself bless Russ Vought’s organization, the Center for Renewing America._ ”

We’ve said it before, but we’re deeply honored to have President Trump’s support and trust.

What’s important though, is that **we****repay that trust with action**.
|
---
| **The Future of America: Join the Fight**
---
| Our country’s future is at stake.

**The deep state MUST be crushed**. The swamp must be drained. The American people must take back their government.

We’re building a team of incredibly courageous individuals, and we’re working around the clock on plans that will help install the America First agenda.

_We need you to join the fight_.

[Please consider a generous contribution to the Center for Renewing America.](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=60c52d0062&e=17913c7d6d)

Every dollar you give will go toward fighting for the America First agenda, taking back our government, and crushing the deep state.

Thanks in advance! Together we can save our country.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48430918/358239291/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220728_fwdfromtaylor&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220728_fwdfromtaylor&refcode2=3329a60b-880e-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzI5YTYwYi04ODBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0Qkuh1lWkr8eHtOb-U8tU8pq9-_shQk6gdGV1OQB2Jc=)
I wanted to reach out because frankly, it’s **unconscionable** that our legislators continue to vote against what _should_ be our most fundamental human right: _The right to love whomever we love._
Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation.
Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a _choice_ — **it’s simply who we are.**
The _choice_ lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. **People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November.**

He is one of the truest treasures of my heart, and I would do absolutely anything to make sure he can live and love in our country as his radiant, authentic self. And as your next Congresswoman, I’ll go to work every day to ensure our fundamental rights aren’t up for debate. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will be processed instantly. | = = = = = = All my best, Patty \---------- Begin forwarded message ---------- Date: Wednesday, July 26, 2022 at 3:31 PM Subject: Mike Flood doesn’t get a say in who I love. To: Team Patty <dpwillis67@gmail.com> Friend, I’m Taylor Pansing Brooks — Patty’s son and a proud LGBTQ+ Nebraskan. = I wanted to reach out because frankly, it’s unconscionable that our legislators continue to vote against what should be our most fundamental human right: The right to love whomever we love. Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation. Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a choice — it’s simply who we are. The choice lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November. = My mom has dedicated her career to ensuring all Nebraskans can enjoy our state’s promise to equality before the law. I’ve worked for every dollar I have to my name, as I’m sure you have too. I know times are tough for everyone right now. But if you can spare anything to help our campaign, we would really appreciate it. Max Miller has had everything handed to him. Meanwhile, we’re relying on everyday Americans who give what they can spare. Sincerely, Matthew Diemer Democratic Candidate for Congress OH-7 | Diemer for Congress P.O.
