Peter,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

** PLEASE LET ME EXPLAIN WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** In June, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a **South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time** , sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. **She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.**

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Fighting for clean elections!
body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch has filed a federal lawsuit against **New York State** and **New York City** election officials failing to remove potentially _hundreds of thousands of ineligible voters_ from New York City registration rolls!
**Judicial Watch is a national leader in voting integrity and voting rights.**
[That’s why I am asking you help us today with a special contribution! ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59524&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59524&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

Federal law requires states to "_conduct a general program that makes a reasonable effort to_ _remove_ " from the official voter rolls "_the names of ineligible voters_ " who have died or changed residence.

But our lawsuit details that New York City's "_own recent data concedes that there were_ _only 22 total removals_ " under this provision "_during a six-year period, in a city of over 5.5 million voters._These are ludicrously small numbers of removals given the sizable__ __populations__ _..._ "

_Dirty voting rolls can mean dirty elections_ , and New York City's rolls are some of the dirtiest in the country. Elections officials in New York City have simply refused to clean the voter lists for years.

We want cleaner elections and we expect this lawsuit will cause New York City to take the simple steps necessary to clean from its voter rolls the names of hundreds of thousands of voters who have moved away or died.

**_You see, where others talk, Judicial Watch acts, and with real impact_!**

**_[And we can do even more if you will join with us and give us your support today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59524&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)_**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59524&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

Our highly experienced team of voting rights attorneys cleaned up voter rolls in **California,** **Ohio, Indiana** , and **Kentucky** , among other achievements. We settled a voter roll clean-up lawsuit against **North Carolina** earlier this year after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from the voter rolls.

We also won in **Maryland** , where a court ruled in favor of our challenge to Maryland's Democratic legislature "extreme" congressional redistricting gerrymander.

We are also suing **Illinois** to prevent state election officials from extending Election Day for 14 days beyond the date established by federal law.

[That's why I urge you to make a special gift](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59524&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=) to help our team of talented investigators and attorneys _challenge and stop efforts to corrupt our elections, and enforce federal law requiring_ _states to clean their voter rolls_!

Your support is vital for us to continue to deliver all the legal action, research, investigations and public education that you and other Americans deserve from America's largest and most effective conservative watchdog.

Thank you!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

But our lawsuit details that New York City's "own recent data concedes that there were only 22 total removals " under this provision "during a six-year period, in a city of over 5.5 million voters.These are ludicrously small numbers of removals given the sizable populations ... " Dirty voting rolls can mean dirty elections , and New York City's rolls are some of the dirtiest in the country. Elections officials in New York City have simply refused to clean the voter lists for years. We want cleaner elections and we expect this lawsuit will cause New York City to take the simple steps necessary to clean from its voter rolls the names of hundreds of thousands of voters who have moved away or died. You see, where others talk, Judicial Watch acts, and with real impact! = = Our highly experienced team of voting rights attorneys cleaned up voter rolls in California, Ohio, Indiana , and Kentucky , among other achievements. We settled a voter roll clean-up lawsuit against North Carolina earlier this year after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from the voter rolls. We also won in Maryland , where a court ruled in favor of our challenge to Maryland's Democratic legislature "extreme" congressional redistricting gerrymander. We are also suing Illinois to prevent state election officials from extending Election Day for 14 days beyond the date established by federal law. = to help our team of talented investigators and attorneys challenge and stop efforts to corrupt our elections, and enforce federal law requiring states to clean their voter rolls_! name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 9 felonies for exposing Planned Parenthood
body:
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64950%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5UPhlWnq9QQ%2brfbRtXq7HQ&sysid=1)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64951%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YQoQr09m6UvewkkTktlVTA&sysid=1)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64952%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Memh6WOZWw06%2btPmr8YDvg&sysid=1)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64953%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JfyLm5YspoWj2n1bMWNl5g&sysid=1)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64954%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lxRHJj%2b2GxkDJa%2fFkfeNYA&sysid=1)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha

They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND of $35, $50, $100 or more to stop this attempt to crush him?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64965%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8VwShUzRL%2fYB566%2fWZoenw&sysid=1)** [**DONATE**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64966%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=O4O65oz3L0W7B6uJuUCeSA&sysid=1) [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64967%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kI1Zw%2fgQerpRqA9WSKscvg&sysid=1) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. Friend,
I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f45c749bf07411297e7afcb67d824d8&_e=hZR_Cr0eusiwulCw5dhcDU9EBUTgCmL5Ec_cAUGZFHQZw5mvp0eueR6WvSl-G24B4ygF19IjjFehZ-EgTyAtza-3ly8Ad_U2FXLt_zpvhFvr1FyNQJODp6oWldF74lI4ua1QzqvIZW8l7jWJEBYgUEIGETWuHubZZDnPdkOvwgxm7166ViGRX22CREnl1YCFyrsJu_xCW8FNrD-UbSWIuogykhMhSaVOhaaLwKrkPcTzZOo6V0xOFnfpRUPQN2nlmGGXJ2uEa_L_PTLWIUeYembeS0CXoMYaiipl3i0HhDLUf7p5MYRrGP5A7xdvJCDnU0bFPtHpWE-32prz1PfMWg%3D%3D)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say — _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f45c749bf07411297e7afcb67d824d8&_e=hZR_Cr0eusiwulCw5dhcDU9EBUTgCmL5Ec_cAUGZFHQZw5mvp0eueR6WvSl-G24B4ygF19IjjFehZ-EgTyAtza-3ly8Ad_U2FXLt_zpvhFvaFldVMQ-MakhYrzp5aAyhQBv1JuRrU7RlVCxZIz7YCZ0wL6SMQNH-xINCPNpBTP_s3RmbTNGEkZ9kfoWWU1e0P3ykfZzY_brvL6-BlFAj9wkHA9HXpbjSPvz0X4FbsW8lL9AmcO8TE2P8orjoDBGZF811i7jV4KdXO3IfeUzBM_dbv1kRzaIVYlMQxPybE3rmQRzLGcxo2JoEMY2aS1L5kAjZF6jrNS_xEe3exi4YIg%3D%3D)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._
Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.
I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.
**As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.**
My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.
With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.
**I’m going to battle for every vote.**
As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!
We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.
Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.
With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.
[**[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f45c749bf07411297e7afcb67d824d8&_e=hZR_Cr0eusiwulCw5dhcDU9EBUTgCmL5Ec_cAUGZFHQZw5mvp0eueR6WvSl-G24B4ygF19IjjFehZ-EgTyAtza-3ly8Ad_U2FXLt_zpvhFs7S-CM8rnl_tzdc-KYoFoyAB-6i8WyZ3aIMW_WwuW-JTGDvyUgQO7hLUMObaRH0-otm3qmCoF1_OscGRq06bDP4qnGUlGznFj4gNBUzY_X3hkaH68nUCtGh-PR8Lg4IOnjH8vdnvSYAMUgJdho7SBN3B_N5igoBF6aBg-iO6I6izSdSj1qyumAym-Viu7I4kgZvoyX2VFSXbMeVS-HQpWlceGzXBSZNdHmTUX0-CGZFw%3D%3D)
Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.
_Friend, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._
No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.
For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Matt Gaetz’s latest outburst reminds us that women need help accessing abortion care right now, and we can all step up to help.
body:
Answer Matt Gaetz by supporting abortion care
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **_“Although your intentions were hateful, your public shaming of my appearance has done nothing but benefit me.”_** These were the words of the incredibly brave Olivia Julianna in response to attacks on her and other pro-choice women by alleged sex traficker, Rep. Matt Gaetz of Florida.
If you sat down to construct the most awful human being you could, combined the seven deadly sins and every bad quality we know to exist, you'd be left with Matt Gaetz. Gaetz, who as we said is being actively investigated by the Justice Department for sex trafficking, shocked nobody when he was one of 20 Republican House members to vote against re-authorizing an anti-sex trafficking law. **Ever the sniveling cretin, Gaetz also got up at a right-wing conference and said, "Why is it that women with the least likelihood of getting pregnant are the ones most worried about having abortions." The crowd for his oh so witty remark--11 yr old boys in locker rooms--were not there to respond. ** **But Julianna was. ** **This courageous 19 year old abortion rights activist in Miami, Fl, was having none of that. In what can only be called an inspiring response--after reminding him he's an "alleged pedophile" and a "small man,"\--[she went ahead and raised $460,000 for ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb31f129b-814f-4c31-99bc-456e7f8e7725/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[_Gen Z For Choice Abortion Fund_ , an organization that splits funds between the 50 states to ensure as many women as possible, who can't afford it or life in red states that have banned their basic rights, don't lose their right to choose. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te9c60c91-7e7b-41f7-9c62-f1d50c332b16/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
---
|
---
| | | | [DONATE NOW: GEN Z FOR CHANGE](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td3c6eb19-3c34-42dc-9131-08ea1dc0a902/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Well, as much as Gaetz repelled us, Julianna inspired us too. It is acts of heroism and defiance like this, by 19 year olds no less, that will be the reason we defeat these aspiring fascists and the regressive policies they support. [**So will you join me in honor of Julianna, women across the country, and, as a big middle finger to Matt Gaetz, in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Gen Z For Choice Abortion Fund, so we can help women across the country continue to control of their lives?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td2c78861-dd3d-4579-ba03-755702c84e87/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you as always for all you do to fight for equality in our country. Cliff

Peter,

Up until just recently, Hispanics were expected and assumed to be Democrats by anyone with a passive interest in political demography. In fact, until recently, Hispanics were about as Democrat as suburbanites were Republican.

I’m helping to change that narrative. I’m not a “coconut” - brown on the outside, white on the inside - as some have called me. And I’m certainly not a “**self-hating Hispanic** ,” as others have labeled me. My name is Monica De La Cruz, a proud Hispanic Republican, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 15th Congressional District to flip a seat RED which has never been held by a Republican in its **HISTORY**.

** PLEASE LET ME EXPLAIN WHY I'M EMAILING YOU TODAY.**

**First:** In June, my friend Mayra Flores made history by flipping a **South Texas U.S. House seat Republican for the first time** , sending a loud message to the entire political class in Washington that as suspected, Hispanic voters are leaving the Democrat Party in DROVES.

**Then:** _Politico_ called my race “**central** ” to Republican’s efforts to flip the House. If you recall, the district I’m running to represent in Congress has **NEVER elected a Republican** to serve our interests in Washington. Democrats have a 100% winning streak dating back to **1903**. ** **

**Now:** I officially have an opponent. After waiting more than a year to find out who my general election opponent is going to be, I’m writing to tell you that I’ll be facing off against Michelle Vallejo. **She’s a far-left Democrat and she just won her primary by a mere 35 votes.**

To be frank, that’s almost incomprehensible. **35 votes**. I’ve been trying to let that sink in. I could easily fit **35** people into my home for an open house. **35** people have been at my campaign headquarters making phone calls and strategizing how to win this pivotal Congressional race.

**[I'm asking 35 conservatives reading this right now to make a gift to my campaign before midnight. body:
In 12 days, the people of the NEW 1st Congressional District will choose which Republican candidate has both the experience and courage necessary. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeremymunson/breaking-i-am-running-for-congress-in-minnesotas-1st-district-9036013?e=f4c2e54596)
---
[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=c9a1d8f4fa&e=f4c2e54596)
Dear Peter,Yes, I am on the ballot for the August 9th Primary for the New First Congressional District and I am asking for your vote. I am also asking you to encourage your friends and family to vote Munson.**WHY I AM RUNNING** With inflation sky high and another recession officially here, I am worried about our country. Now, more than ever, we need to elect fiscal conservatives who will correct the trajectory of our economy. Inflation and its effect on the economy is the number one issue for our district. This isn’t caused by just “the Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi agenda.” It’s caused by runaway spending and the endless printing of money. In short, both Democrats and big-spending Republicans have done this to us. Most Republicans voted to spend $7 trillion in a single year. We are now over $30 trillion in debt. Interest rates are climbing, which makes our debt payments increase.Like Congressman Hagedorn, I am a fiscal conservative. I am the only fiscal conservative on the August 9 ballot. My positions on issues have remained consistent. This country does not need more squishy politicians. I was proud to call Congressman Hagedorn my friend. He won this district by campaigning and later voting as a limited government, fiscal conservative. Unlike the other candidates on the ballot, I agreed with his voting record and will represent this district in a similar manner.As a state legislator, I earned a reputation for being a liberty-minded, fiscal-hawk. I consistently called out wasteful projects, voted to reduce spending, and introduced legislation to refund surplus money to taxpayers.I am also the only candidate in this race who has vowed NOT to raise the debt ceiling. $30 Trillion is enough!As a state legislator, I fought for election integrity. I authored legislation requiring voter ID’s and provisional ballots. I also sued the Secretary of State for unconstitutionally changing our election laws. I believe state election laws must be followed to hold a legitimate election. The courts found MN did not follow its election laws in 2020. Like Congressman Hagedorn, for this reason, I would have voted to not certify the 2020 electors.**THE ESTABLISHMENT, SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS AND THE INFLUENCE OF MONEY IN POLITICS** During the special primary, the establishment and special interest groups swamped the election with outside money. One thing I learned over the past few years is that if a candidate will agree to spend money to support special interest groups, those groups will spend an unimaginable amount of money electing such candidate. Just as Republicans will never outspend Democrats, fiscal conservative Republican candidates will never be able to outspend the big spending Republican candidates and the super PACs that support them. $2.6 million dollars flooded the district with mailers and TV ads from anti-Trump SuperPACs supporting my opponent, ironically portraying him as a Trump Conservative.At the April 24th CD1 Endorsing convention for the November election, I received 55% of votes from the delegates. Brad only reached 35%. The remaining delegates, mostly Republican Party Leaders and elected legislators, voted not to endorse. In a speech after the fifth ballot, I said, “If we do not endorse a candidate today, the Super PACs will choose our candidate.” This was not far from the truth.My voting record and interviews earned me endorsements from Senators Rand Paul & Ted Cruz, Congressmen Jim Jordan, Thomas Massie, and House Freedom Caucus Chairman Congressman Scott Perry. Rand Paul’s support included a TV buy, but in the end, we were outspent by the RINO PACs who used outright lies, twisted versions of the truth and propaganda to attack me and support their candidate.**ADDRESSING THE CURRENT SLANDER AND SMEAR CAMPAIGN** After the primary, I stated that I would support Brad in the special general. However, unlike the attacks upon me imply, I have NEVER stated that I would support Brad in the regular primary election or that I would not run in this race. The regular primary is a separate race, involving different voters than the special primary. The words ‘special general on August 9’ were used in my press release on purpose to be very specific. I also talked with the state party and made certain they understood the intent of my statement.I posted that press release to let voters know that I would not be asking for a recount, even though the count was extremely close. I stood by this statement. This was my sixth race, but my first loss. Losing by 1% puts you on an emotional roller coaster, creating a dozen scenarios which could have made that 1% difference. If 10 people in each of the counties would have voted for me instead of Brad, we’d have a different result. It was close.My statement was an honest snapshot of my emotions at the time. Unlike many of the people who primaried me, I wanted to show my daughters how one acts with humility, and good sportsmanship when winning and when losing. I wanted to acknowledge that Brad won the special primary and I was not going to be on the special general ballot, and yes, the conservatives would have to vote for him to keep the seat in Republican hands. For those who would like to read my actual and full statement for themselves, the post remains on my page.Brad was the only candidate invited to the special endorsing convention held less than 48 hours after the polls closed and before the results of the special primary were even certified. There was no ability for other candidates to mount an endorsement challenge, or even call all the delegates in the few hours following the election to explain how the races were different. We are used to special endorsing conventions when the non-endorsed candidate wins a primary. We did this for Hagedorn when he ran against the endorsed candidate in 2014. But this endorsement, portrayed as a special endorsing convention, was not for the special election – it was for the regular election and the regular primary was still months away. I will leave it to you to decide how much value you give to an endorsement made in this manner. Frankly, I thought how the entire process was handled undermined the very purpose of the party, starting with elected chairs standing to vote against an endorsement at the first convention.**WHAT YOU CAN DO TO HELP** I am asking for your vote, and for you to call a few friends and ask them to cast a ballot for me in the August 9 primary. Without a gubernatorial primary, there will be very low voter turnout. We can win this election if you help to spread the word. Please share my posts and talk with your friends and neighbors about my campaign. Ask them to vote Munson in the primary and remind them again to get out and vote on election day. You can vote now, in-person [at your county elections office](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=085d3b8b0d&e=f4c2e54596). Bring a friend, neighbor, or co-worker. Cast your ballot to bring real change to DC.**WE CAN WIN!** Voters from new counties will be voting in this regular primary race. This is an extremely odd situation involving two races plus redistricting. The “regular primary” is a different and separate race than the “special general” and involves different groups of voters. Only Brad and I are running in the Republican primary. We are not running against a democrat in this race. The misleading message by my opponent’s campaign that ‘Munson is splitting the vote with Finstad and giving the race to Ettinger’ is ignorant or purposefully meant to mislead voters.In the hours after the filing, I received many calls of support. The most moving calls were from voters in Wabasha and Goodhue counties. Their entire counties were excluded from the special primary election because they were not part of the OLD first district. I have enjoyed campaigning in this new area and I have received strong support. My friend Steve Drazkowski has represented much of that area for more than a decade and is running for State Senate across both Wabasha and Goodhue Counties. Steve is the leader of our caucus in St Paul and Republicans in the area love freedom and limited government. Electorally, the NEW First District is much different from the Old District. These are two different races.The results of the special primary in May were extremely close. In a ten-way race, Brad received 38% of the vote and I received 37%. The rest of the vote was split between the eight other candidates. No one received a majority. For this reason, many states have a run-off primary where the top two winners of the primary face off so that one must win a majority.Democrats believe in appointing successors, but we are Conservatives. We believe in the voting process and real meaningful representation. Leadership in St Paul expects the counties of Goodhue and Wabasha to roll out the Red Carpet for a candidate who won an election they had no say in. They deserve the right to choose their Congressman for the next two years. August 9th is not a ceremonial victory for Brad, but rather a real chance for the New First Congressional District to choose whether they think a fiscal conservative or a big-spender will save our country from this recession.**MY PROMISE TO YOU** Having served and actively fought for liberty each day during the COVID lockdowns, experienced the emotional pain of my wife’s cancer diagnosis and treatment, the loss of my friend Congressman Hagedorn, and having answered the call to mount an unexpected special election campaign for Congress, my family and I have enjoyed the past two months spending more time together – it was a much-needed break from politics. However, after much prayer, discussion and thought about the direction of this country and the type of candidate our country and state needs at this time, I want voters to know, I am ready to fight for them. I promise each day I serve to give 100% and to continually try to outwork all others in Congress. I promise to always be transparent and honest about my votes, reasoning and positions. I promise to always vote in a principled manner that supports your liberty and shows fiscal restraint and responsibility. I promise to always place the people of southern Minnesota first, and never become beholden to special interest groups or advancing a political career.Thank you for all your support and words of encouragement! Let’s win!
Jeremy Munson
Candidate for Congress

clean_body: In 12 days, the people of the NEW 1st Congressional District will choose which Republican candidate has both the experience and courage necessary. | | | Dear Peter,Yes, I am on the ballot for the August 9th Primary for the New First Congressional District and I am asking for your vote. I am also asking you to encourage your friends and family to vote Munson.WHY I AM RUNNING With inflation sky high and another recession officially here, I am worried about our country. Now, more than ever, we need to elect fiscal conservatives who will correct the trajectory of our economy. Inflation and its effect on the economy is the number one issue for our district. This isn’t caused by just “the Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi agenda.” It’s caused by runaway spending and the endless printing of money. In short, both Democrats and big-spending Republicans have done this to us. Most Republicans voted to spend $7 trillion in a single year. We are now over $30 trillion in debt. Interest rates are climbing, which makes our debt payments increase.Like Congressman Hagedorn, I am a fiscal conservative. I am the only fiscal conservative on the August 9 ballot. My positions on issues have remained consistent. This country does not need more squishy politicians. I was proud to call Congressman Hagedorn my friend. He won this district by campaigning and later voting as a limited government, fiscal conservative. Unlike the other candidates on the ballot, I agreed with his voting record and will represent this district in a similar manner.As a state legislator, I earned a reputation for being a liberty-minded, fiscal-hawk. I consistently called out wasteful projects, voted to reduce spending, and introduced legislation to refund surplus money to taxpayers.I am also the only candidate in this race who has vowed NOT to raise the debt ceiling. $30 Trillion is enough!As a state legislator, I fought for election integrity. I authored legislation requiring voter ID’s and provisional ballots. I also sued the Secretary of State for unconstitutionally changing our election laws. I believe state election laws must be followed to hold a legitimate election. The courts found MN did not follow its election laws in 2020. Like Congressman Hagedorn, for this reason, I would have voted to not certify the 2020 electors.THE ESTABLISHMENT, SPECIAL INTEREST GROUPS AND THE INFLUENCE OF MONEY IN POLITICS During the special primary, the establishment and special interest groups swamped the election with outside money. One thing I learned over the past few years is that if a candidate will agree to spend money to support special interest groups, those groups will spend an unimaginable amount of money electing such candidate. Just as Republicans will never outspend Democrats, fiscal conservative Republican candidates will never be able to outspend the big spending Republican candidates and the super PACs that support them. $2.6 million dollars flooded the district with mailers and TV ads from anti-Trump SuperPACs supporting my opponent, ironically portraying him as a Trump Conservative.At the April 24th CD1 Endorsing convention for the November election, I received 55% of votes from the delegates. Brad only reached 35%. The remaining delegates, mostly Republican Party Leaders and elected legislators, voted not to endorse. In a speech after the fifth ballot, I said, “If we do not endorse a candidate today, the Super PACs will choose our candidate.” This was not far from the truth.My voting record and interviews earned me endorsements from Senators Rand Paul & Ted Cruz, Congressmen Jim Jordan, Thomas Massie, and House Freedom Caucus Chairman Congressman Scott Perry. Rand Paul’s support included a TV buy, but in the end, we were outspent by the RINO PACs who used outright lies, twisted versions of the truth and propaganda to attack me and support their candidate.ADDRESSING THE CURRENT SLANDER AND SMEAR CAMPAIGN After the primary, I stated that I would support Brad in the special general. However, unlike the attacks upon me imply, I have NEVER stated that I would support Brad in the regular primary election or that I would not run in this race. The regular primary is a separate race, involving different voters than the special primary. The words ‘special general on August 9’ were used in my press release on purpose to be very specific. I also talked with the state party and made certain they understood the intent of my statement.I posted that press release to let voters know that I would not be asking for a recount, even though the count was extremely close. I stood by this statement. This was my sixth race, but my first loss. Losing by 1% puts you on an emotional roller coaster, creating a dozen scenarios which could have made that 1% difference. If 10 people in each of the counties would have voted for me instead of Brad, we’d have a different result. It was close.My statement was an honest snapshot of my emotions at the time. Unlike many of the people who primaried me, I wanted to show my daughters how one acts with humility, and good sportsmanship when winning and when losing. I wanted to acknowledge that Brad won the special primary and I was not going to be on the special general ballot, and yes, the conservatives would have to vote for him to keep the seat in Republican hands. For those who would like to read my actual and full statement for themselves, the post remains on my page.Brad was the only candidate invited to the special endorsing convention held less than 48 hours after the polls closed and before the results of the special primary were even certified. We are used to special endorsing conventions when the non-endorsed candidate wins a primary. We did this for Hagedorn when he ran against the endorsed candidate in 2014. But this endorsement, portrayed as a special endorsing convention, was not for the special election – it was for the regular election and the regular primary was still months away. I will leave it to you to decide how much value you give to an endorsement made in this manner. Frankly, I thought how the entire process was handled undermined the very purpose of the party, starting with elected chairs standing to vote against an endorsement at the first convention.WHAT YOU CAN DO TO HELP I am asking for your vote, and for you to call a few friends and ask them to cast a ballot for me in the August 9 primary. Without a gubernatorial primary, there will be very low voter turnout. We can win this election if you help to spread the word. Please share my posts and talk with your friends and neighbors about my campaign. Ask them to vote Munson in the primary and remind them again to get out and vote on election day. You can vote now, in-person . Bring a friend, neighbor, or co-worker. Cast your ballot to bring real change to DC.WE CAN WIN! Voters from new counties will be voting in this regular primary race. This is an extremely odd situation involving two races plus redistricting. The “regular primary” is a different and separate race than the “special general” and involves different groups of voters. Only Brad and I are running in the Republican primary. We are not running against a democrat in this race. The misleading message by my opponent’s campaign that ‘Munson is splitting the vote with Finstad and giving the race to Ettinger’ is ignorant or purposefully meant to mislead voters.In the hours after the filing, I received many calls of support. The most moving calls were from voters in Wabasha and Goodhue counties. Their entire counties were excluded from the special primary election because they were not part of the OLD first district. I have enjoyed campaigning in this new area and I have received strong support. My friend Steve Drazkowski has represented much of that area for more than a decade and is running for State Senate across both Wabasha and Goodhue Counties. Steve is the leader of our caucus in St Paul and Republicans in the area love freedom and limited government. Electorally, the NEW First District is much different from the Old District. These are two different races.The results of the special primary in May were extremely close. In a ten-way race, Brad received 38% of the vote and I received 37%. The rest of the vote was split between the eight other candidates. No one received a majority. For this reason, many states have a run-off primary where the top two winners of the primary face off so that one must win a majority.Democrats believe in appointing successors, but we are Conservatives. We believe in the voting process and real meaningful representation. Leadership in St Paul expects the counties of Goodhue and Wabasha to roll out the Red Carpet for a candidate who won an election they had no say in. name: Wes Moore
subject: urgently need your support in Maryland, Derek
body:
Wes Moore is running to build a Maryland that works for everyone. Will you split a donation between his campaign and CommonGood today so he can defeat Trump-backed extremist Dan Cox? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Moore]
Derek,
It’s now official.
I am proud to report – with humility and pride – that I am the Democratic nominee to be Maryland’s next Governor.
If you can help us kick off this general election campaign by splitting a contribution between my campaign and CommonGood, chip in here, and together, we’re going to get this done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Moore]
When you consider my opponent, the Republican nominee Dan Cox, the stakes have quite literally never been higher.
Marylanders will face a very clear choice this November.
A choice between unity and division. A choice between a future built on hope and optimism vs. the cynical politics of conspiracy theories and fear. A choice between the values we embrace as Marylanders and Donald Trump’s divisive and dangerous MAGA movement.
When I led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan as a Captain in the U.S. Army, we lived by a principle: leave no one behind.
This principle is not a slogan. It’s a value that drives this campaign.
It’s a value that will guide me as Governor of Maryland.
Right now, too many Marylanders are being left behind. Unable to fill the gas tank or keep up with monthly bills. Feeling unsafe in their own communities, or with their children trapped in schools that are not preparing their children for the jobs of today or tomorrow.
That all must change.
We get there with new ideas, and a new spirit of togetherness – working across party lines and regional lines, through civility and collaboration.
That’s an approach my opponent, Dan Cox, doesn’t believe in.
Cox has pledged his unwavering allegiance to Donald Trump. Cox personally organized buses of insurrectionists to the U.S. Capitol on January 6. He spread Trump’s lies about the 2020 election and fought to have it overturned. He traffics in conspiracy theories. He tried to impeach Governor Hogan. Cox represents the most extreme fringe of American politics.
Simply put, Dan Cox is so far outside the mainstream that I believe he’d be dangerous in the Governor's office.
And it’s not just about Donald Trump – abortion access is on the ballot. Public school funding is on the ballot. A $15 minimum wage is on the ballot. The future of our environment is on the ballot.
I believe Maryland is the best state in America to live and raise a family, but to fulfill our potential, we must make sure all Marylanders have that opportunity at success.
So that’s what’s at stake this November.
We’ve got work to do, and aren’t taking our opponent lightly for even a minute.
We’ve got more voters to talk to about our message, and our campaign is going to have to grow. If you can help us kick off this general election campaign with a contribution, chip in here, and together, we’re going to get this done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Moore]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Moore&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Moore&amount=35]

Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220728_CGVA_Moore]
From the bottom of my heart, on behalf of my family and my amazing running mate, Delegate Aruna Miller, I thank you for the opportunity to serve.
Onward to victory,
Wes

| | Hi Peter - As I have met with people across the district, I have heard stories about caring for family members that are similar to my family’s experience. My dad struggles with Alzheimer’s disease, and my mom is his full-time caregiver. My siblings and I are there to help, and we are so thankful that the Cranston Adult Day Care Center gives my mom a break a couple days a week. Being a full-time caregiver for a family member or friend is rewarding and challenging. It often means they sacrifice their own needs. I believe supporting our family caregivers is a public health issue, and I will work in Congress to provide the resources and support infrastructure that they need. I will **strengthen Lifespan Respite Care legislation** , which provides short-term relief for caregivers so they can take time for themselves. I support **expanding Medicaid coverage** to provide additional support for family caregivers. This is also included in the Build Back Better proposal, which would permanently improve Medicaid coverage for home care services for seniors and people with disabilities. I also believe that **creating a permanent, broad-based national paid leave program** is essential for helping caregivers balance their work and family responsibilities. During the Covid-19 pandemic, Congress passed temporary paid leave for some workers, and I will work to pass permanent paid leave to support working family caregivers in all sectors and at all times.
I’m passionate about delivering on these legislative items, not just because they are personal to me, but because these are the same issues that I hear when I am talking to people. body:
The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary, James Judge, earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bc12d0db4654/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13683888?e=00028e5542)
---
[**FL-14 frontrunner James Judge endorsed by hometown newspaper, the Tampa Bay Times**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=e3f848f3e2&e=00028e5542)
_The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary, James Judge, earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times editorial board on Wednesday._ TAMPA, Fla. – The leader in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary race was endorsed in his primary race by the Tampa Bay Times, his hometown newspaper, and the largest paper in the southeast U.S.“The Times’s endorsement is the honor of a lifetime and certainly one of the highlights of my campaign,” said Judge. “I am extremely blessed and grateful to receive this endorsement, and I am looking forward to becoming the Republican Party’s nominee on August 23.”“Though I’ve often found myself at odds with The Times over political issues, and while I fully expect the paper to endorse my Democrat opponent Kathy Castor in the general election, it made the right choice in this primary race,” Judge said.The paper praised Judge, noting that while he is a strong conservative, he is offering practical solutions to issues that matter to American voters.“Judge’s rhetoric has a strident tone, but he also shows a regard for Florida’s natural environment, and a practical side on some hot-button issues, including immigration,” the paper said. “He supports a ban on offshore drilling near Florida, and efforts to reduce global-warming greenhouse gas emissions. And Judge is open to a balanced approach to immigration that includes strengthening border security and creating a process through probation and fines where undocumented immigrants might obtain legal status.”The Times also recognized the Judge campaign’s efforts to engage with voters in the district. His primary opponent has been noticeably absent from the campaign trail.The Times’s endorsement is another in a long line of nods from local national political figures.Judge has been endorsed by legendary political consultant Roger Stone, Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Bob Beauprez endorses Erik Aadland
body:
The support grows...
| | | |
---
---
|
# State Representative Brophy Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(July 28, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from former CD7 Congressman, Bob Beauprez.

Bob Beauprez is a rancher, former banker and politician from Boulder County. He attended the University of Colorado and graduated with a degree in physical education.

Beauprez was made chair of the Boulder County Republicans in 1997, and two years later was named chairman of the Colorado Republican Party. Beauprez represented Colorado's Seventh Congressional District from 2003-2007 and ran for Governor of Colorado in 2006 and 2014.

A devout Catholic and member of the Republican Party, Beauprez has long maintained his stance as a moderate conservative.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Beauprez said:
"It was a privilege to serve as the first Representative of District 7, so I know well what it takes to do the job. Erik Aadland has all the right stuff to not only fit into the role, but to excel as a Member of Congress. Erik's life has been one of exceptional service, always rising to leadership responsibility whether in the military or private sector. It will be the same when he's in Congress. He has a passion for America, an instinctive healthy common-sense for right and wrong, and a very large servant's heart. It is my honor to offer my strongest endorsement of Erik Aadland as the next Representative from District 7 to Congress."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am honored to have Bob Beauprez's endorsement. Just as he rose to the challenge of representing Coloradans in a new congressional district, I am ready to understand the changing needs of the newly redistricted Congressional District 7's citizens and advocate for them in Washington."
---
---
| |
---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

name: Team Benson
subject: A bit of campaign news from July
body:
Friend,
This month, Jocelyn traveled around the state and had some great conversations with voters, It gave members of our team a chance to play ‘photographer’ and capture those moments on camera (you’ll see them below!).
Every member of Team Benson enjoyed meeting Michiganders in person and hearing their thoughts on where we’re headed as a state and a nation. Even with so much turmoil, belief in our democracy remains strong and from what we’ve heard over the past month many people share this feeling.
Without further ado, here are some updates from July
Earlier this month, Jocelyn received the Defenders of Democracy award from The Center for Election Innovation and Research. This award recognizes the efforts Jocelyn and all the election workers in Michigan have done to ensure that our elections continue to be accurate and fair.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93087/images/JB%20Democracy%20Award.png]
Jocelyn wanted us to share with you several important news stories from this past month about the issues she and our election officials face. Check them out below and make sure to them with your friends and family. >>
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/jul/23/january-6-hearings-us-democracy-roadmap-autocracy [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/jul/23/january-6-hearings-us-democracy-roadmap-autocracy]
Read this Article [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/jul/23/january-6-hearings-us-democracy-roadmap-autocracy]
https://www.politico.com/news/2022/07/13/election-fraud-local-states-00045444 [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/07/13/election-fraud-local-states-00045444]
Read this Article [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/07/13/election-fraud-local-states-00045444]
July in Michigan is not complete without attending (or marching) in one of the many amazing 4th of July parades around the state. As promised, here are some photos of Jocelyn and the team in Clawson!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/504D4D6B427841467067433241773572626843704A58616B7A796B745452676F57335332314F3958584A2F304834477A436E5249526B4245564D4F70554F6B79/editor_images/JB%20parade%201.png]
Jocelyn marching in the 4th of July parade!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/504D4D6B427841467067433241773572626843704A58616B7A796B745452676F57335332314F3958584A2F304834477A436E5249526B4245564D4F70554F6B79/editor_images/JB%20Parade%202_1.png]
After marching, Jocelyn got together with supporters after the parade!
This month Jocelyn was elected to serve as secretary for the National Association of Secretaries of State (NASS). The NASS is the nation’s oldest, nonpartisan professional organization for public officials, and a great platform to help foster interstate collaboration on public policy. This is another exciting opportunity for Jocelyn to represent Michigan in working with other states and helping shape the discourse on national policy!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/504D4D6B427841467067433241773572626843704A58616B7A796B745452676F57335332314F3958584A2F304834477A436E5249526B4245564D4F70554F6B79/editor_images/JB%20NASS.png]
Lastly, we’d be amiss if we didn’t end this newsletter by asking you to support the campaign. Our grassroots donations are critical to fueling this operation and making sure that Jocelyn prevails in November.
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=072722&refcode2=983fcdf5-960e-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a] Friend so as we wrap up this month could you pitch in to our campaign fund and ensure that our pro-democracy coalition prevails on Election Day? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=072722&refcode2=983fcdf5-960e-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a]
Donate Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=072722]
Thanks for reading and hope the rest of your summer is both safe and fun-filled!
-Team Benson

Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
PO Box 21368
Detroit, MI 48221
United States

The most successful public policy programs in the history of this country.
We have some exciting news to share with you, Peter:

Derek was endorsed by the progressive champions at the National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare!
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/dIfAHju14FC4a5hQ3LF5cjC9nJm0V71MI6PY9vqVR-Y=/8bpZtXpPntz2BhYWgu221WQVW3l3OTNJrDW_nEdm_xY=?refcode=em22_220728_medeom_fndd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220728_medeom_fndd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})
Derek is strongly committed to making sure we do everything we can to protect Social Security and Medicare. We should all want to defend our earned benefits and ensure our seniors can retire with dignity.

Social Security and Medicare are two of the most successful public policy programs in the history of this country. Derek is proud to have been an original cosponsor of the Social Security 2100 Act that would extend Social Security's solvency for more than 75 years and simultaneously improve benefits.

Protecting Social Security for today's retirees - and for future retirees - and expanding access to affordable, accessible health care is crucial to millions of Americans. **More attacks will be volleyed at these crucial programs. Derek is beyond grateful to have the National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare - and this team - by his side as he fights to make our economy work for everyone.**

Thank you for your support!

subject: Send Liz Cheney packing
body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country...
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvvho32kgf0du5t8bkrdctek7cegn70n2e2pbm68_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrm0sr3mhgmcp5gmep78cr6meo6cdjn6ipr0p1gmdhb8dr16eqe1pjhcdhneob7mv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i65j78pplm5jrcoj665ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clie0ob2c1h6eoh5u)
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zih83fs4lv1mnk84ceud2onmduuqg3qsvc0bnvto_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zre3deoo7scl9vieob1nemh1aqi67ed34h5acbn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z2m55reifqpot5qubkr7cpcbd2ls2ocuoetfcl6g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqei054o0r5pg12if6v54rl9vklrvnihuvvam89g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpuu3s7k5d9j5tsj8fhg8m3v6evup8drmj9276do_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zct05rb45ckj6ej5hfei89s852g4cncbodmt5q30_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zagm2h12mdel054g7cevsb0kj8jrr0emuu0li628_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zn68s828tbo90k759p8escovrfk8seocuqu9me3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z19k9370k5oeou9an4m1gjifegm57lku6so8r1vg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1q14ooevff8sqjhfirigrudr45bf1mcsk7mt0mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zirc38b6809nbv9oqc3plfk48f2laj1v24mkrs2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s1gm4o32cth2bs)

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Bob Beauprez endorses Erik Aadland
body:
The support grows...
| | | |
---
---
|
# Former Congressman Beauprez Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(July 28, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from former CD7 Congressman, Bob Beauprez.

Bob Beauprez is a rancher, former banker and politician from Boulder County. He attended the University of Colorado and graduated with a degree in physical education.

Beauprez was made chair of the Boulder County Republicans in 1997, and two years later was named chairman of the Colorado Republican Party. Beauprez represented Colorado's Seventh Congressional District from 2003-2007 and ran for Governor of Colorado in 2006 and 2014.

A devout Catholic and member of the Republican Party, Beauprez has long maintained his stance as a moderate conservative.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Beauprez said:
"It was a privilege to serve as the first Representative of District 7, so I know well what it takes to do the job. Erik Aadland has all the right stuff to not only fit into the role, but to excel as a Member of Congress. Erik's life has been one of exceptional service, always rising to leadership responsibility whether in the military or private sector. It will be the same when he's in Congress. He has a passion for America, an instinctive healthy common-sense for right and wrong, and a very large servant's heart. It is my honor to offer my strongest endorsement of Erik Aadland as the next Representative from District 7 to Congress."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am honored to have Bob Beauprez's endorsement. Just as he rose to the challenge of representing Coloradans in a new congressional district, I am ready to understand the changing needs of the newly redistricted Congressional District 7's citizens and advocate for them in Washington."

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

Bob Beauprez is a rancher, former banker and politician from Boulder County. He attended the University of Colorado and graduated with a degree in physical education. Beauprez was made chair of the Boulder County Republicans in 1997, and two years later was named chairman of the Colorado Republican Party. Beauprez represented Colorado's Seventh Congressional District from 2003-2007 and ran for Governor of Colorado in 2006 and 2014. A devout Catholic and member of the Republican Party, Beauprez has long maintained his stance as a moderate conservative. | In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Beauprez said: "It was a privilege to serve as the first Representative of District 7, so I know well what it takes to do the job. Americans deserve the right to marry, regardless of their race, gender, or orientation. But millions of marriages could soon be in jeopardy.

Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas wants the Court to "reconsider" its ruling on marriage equality. That’s why it's crucial that Congress codify marriage equality before it's too late.

Bob is fighting to pass the Respect for Marriage Act — a bill with bipartisan support that has already passed the House of Representatives. We need your help to show Republican senators that you want them to join Bob in passing this critical bill in the Senate.

[**Will you take action to protect marriages across the Nation today? Tell Republican senators to codify marriage equality now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48453069/358319901/-707902946?ms=em22_220728_marrge_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&refcode=em22_220728_marrge_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&source=em22_220728_marrge_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220728_marrge_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=FOE1ikqBTBjTd5dIvNF1JVt9q0EG70kh%2F2tqXsmkDFkWfKjXjMM3AL2DK2IeG1DiGgpej0dE5sWhImZxS7opTK9jyOwJ5BTePuIPYHejIcr4lKydrfb1p4L%2FWwuFmC4cHPrB5Em1WI6o2ierP2hb2ffEWPk8UkBGkzNdXueff94B83BZXCO7nyhzgVMt7nOO&contactdata=FOE1ikqBTBjTd5dIvNF1JVt9q0EG70kh%2F2tqXsmkDFkWfKjXjMM3AL2DK2IeG1DiGgpej0dE5sWhImZxS7opTK9jyOwJ5BTePuIPYHejIcr4lKydrfb1p4L%2FWwuFmC4cHPrB5Em1WI6o2ierP2hb2ffEWPk8UkBGkzNdXueff94B83BZXCO7nyhzgVMt7nOO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYTRlOWQ4OS1iZDBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BVuYuOgDuiXT6JU5Nh1HG2m__NN6A_MhRmSzBp9VZvc=&emci=a322fd5b-8c0e-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=0a4e9d89-bd0e-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725) The Respect for Marriage Act would make marriage equality for millions of families and loving partners the law of the land.
