| The real Wolf of Wall Street, Jordan Belfort. Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon. Conservative legend Dennis Prager. Country music star Randy Houser.
What do these people have in common? All of them will be at my 3rd annual Youth Summit in October.
That's right, the Crenshaw Youth Summit is back and is right around the corner. Mark your calendars now for October 8 - 9, and we'll see you at the Hilton Americas in Houston, TX.
Scroll down to get your exclusive first look at this year's lineup. This is the only summit on the planet where you can hear from all of the icons I mentioned above, in addition to a host of interesting and impactful speakers. From North Korean dissidents to leading scientists to thought leaders in the conservative movement, the 2022 Crenshaw Youth Summit has it all. You're not going to want to miss this.
This year, we're going to make the youth summit more relaxed. Based on attendee feedback from last year - instead of one long, jam-packed conference day - we're breaking it up into two shorter days. We're adding more meet-and-greets and networking events with speakers to keep this year's summit dynamic and engaging.
Tickets go on sale next week. Tell your friends to sign up now at [crenshawyouthsummit.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nIpLfUv74u1VkWz9Zqm8_v0f-gdG7UQNwXiPagMgpM2ulhwCl9hqZCVUP8pNnyWnNUuH5jirvEXMXPlpNBTpJYR8qpZzeV3e4T8HHLVXaPYc3o1JLw78nBKrryS5ev2gwRlZ6jY98nAu964ca1BucIlJ1DWLJku_&c=VA4SySzQxEhXodxcAbbn104BlROYmajkvAl5SIIX-rfcn_KgDt2nDA==&ch=HvNawN6pZNOrIKhsmQ9uOF6tUsrcjm5bAglTdBDJLyzpyqzXXqFtRw==) to get first notice when tickets become available.

Jordan Belfort's legendary early career was depicted by Leonardo DiCaprio in The Wolf of Wall Street. His redemption story is equally fascinating. Today, Jordan is a speaker, writer, entrepreneurship expert, and sales master who has trained millions of people across the globe. He's bringing that knowledge to the Crenshaw Youth Summit to teach you how to be a young entrepreneur and reach your fullest potential in business and life.
---
|
---
Seth Dillon is the CEO of The Babylon Bee. Taking on the tone of a traditional news media publication, The Bee hilariously satirizes real-world events and public figures. Seth joins us to talk about building the wildly successful conservative news satire site in an era of censorship and cancel culture.
---
| |
---
|
---
Country music star Randy Houser has multiple chart-topping hits including "How Country Feels", "Like A Cowboy", and "Running Out of Moonlight." Randy and his band are performing a live show on Saturday night that you and your friends will never forget.
---
|
---
Dave Rubin is an author, comedian, and TV personality best known for his political commentary. He is the host of The Rubin Report, a top-ranking talk show recognized as one of the most influential spaces for candid conversations about complex issues and current events. Dave returns for the second time to the Crenshaw Youth Summit to teach you how to think for yourself in an age when tribal outrage is the only available alternative.
---
| |
---
|
---
Dennis Prager is one of the most respected and influential thinkers, writers, and speakers in America. He is the founder of Prager University (PragerU) - the most viewed conservative video site in the world. He joins us to talk about preserving America, the West, and the Judeo-Christian value system.
---
|
---
Born in a punishing society devoted to the worship of Kim Jong-Il, North Korean defector, human rights activist, and TED Speaker Yeonmi Park is a leading voice of oppressed people around the world. At the age of 13, she and her family made a daring escape to China in search of a life free of tyranny. She joins us to recount this incredible story, how we fight tyranny, and the fundamental concepts of freedoms that westerners take for granted.
---
| |
---
|
---
Bjørn Lomborg researches the smartest ways to do good. He is coming to show us how to find and promote the most effective solutions to the world's greatest challenges, from disease and hunger to climate and education.
---
|
---
Rich Lowry is the Editor of National Review, the legendary conservative editorial magazine founded by William F. Buckley. Rich joins us to make the case for conservatism and reinvigorating the American National Identity.

_**Democrats See Republicans as the Enemy, Not As Loyal Opposition**_ By Bobby Jindal
---
Democrats have long portrayed Donald Trump as a singular threat to democracy, who deserves to be driven from the public square and polite company. Their contempt has rested on ever-changing rationales—from crude behavior and tweets to Russian collaboration to the January 6th attack. It seems Democrats would much rather look backwards than focus on the future. Democrats attack potential Republican candidates as tainted for working for Trump (e.g., Mike Pompeo, Mike Pence, and Nikki Haley), being enabled by Trump (e.g., Governors Ron DeSantis and Glenn Youngkin), or not denouncing him (e.g., Senators Ted Cruz, Marco Rubio, and Tom Cotton). Even Republicans willing to risk political suicide by denouncing their party's recent leader and most popular figure can never do so vociferously and constantly enough to appease Democrats. Do Democrats really view Trump as an existential threat, or is that merely a convenient talking point? They tend to harness the same arguments against every Republican, undermining their claims' credibility. They further undermine them by cynically spending millions to support Trump's favored primary candidates in Maryland, Pennsylvania, and other states, hoping they will be easier to defeat. Democratic revulsion at Trump and other Republicans feeds leftists' view of themselves as virtuous social justice warriors heroically crusading against society's many structural evils. They reject bipartisanship and refuse to regard Republicans as a loyal opposition. Adapting Barry Goldwater's "moderation in the pursuit of justice is no virtue," liberals see compromise with conservatives as moral failure. They reject norms of civility and cheer the harassment of conservative Supreme Court Justices and Trump officials. The ends justify the means when you see white supremacists lurking behind every corner, and applaud yourself for fighting racism and sexism in every political disagreement. Any Republican nominee is going to share most of Trump's core policy positions, as these positions are popular with Republican voters. These positions are not popular because Trump championed them, but rather Trump is popular because he championed these positions. Republican voters believed he would fight for them and their values more effectively than his predecessors did. While others paid lip service to securing the border or appointing conservative judges, Trump followed through. Even when he wasn't successful, he delighted in the fight and didn't simply use the policies to win primary votes and forget them after his election. Even moderate Republicans willing to oppose Trump are unlikely to reject these policies. Any Republican nominee will oppose illegal immigration and support tighter border security. They will fight race-based identity politics that reject intent or personal agency as irrelevant and claim disparate outcomes prove structural racism. They will promote individual actions and responsibilities over group identity and oppose school curricula that teach students they are victims or perpetrators based on the color of their skin. They will reject historical revisionism that portrays America as inherently racist and founded to preserve slavery and support patriotic civics education that views America as a unique force for freedom. They will reject mask mandates, and support empowering parents concerning curricular and school closure decisions.
Any Republican nominee will favor tax cuts and deregulation over more government spending. They will favor lower capital gains, income, and estate taxes, and will fight to continue cutting taxes when Trump's cuts expire. They will favor legislation allowing Medicaid work requirements for the able-bodied and more freedom for consumers to select the coverage that meets their needs. They will not automatically embrace free trade and will insist on fair trade deals, especially regarding China and its theft of intellectual property. They will not automatically favor the interests of big businesses, and will be skeptical of Big Tech and companies with outsized market concentration. Any Republican nominee will promote election integrity, vowing to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat. They will favor voter identification and restrictions on ballot boxes, ballot harvesting, and expanded voting dates. Any Republican nominee will support increased defense spending, but be more skeptical of foreign interventions and troop deployments. They will support Israel as America's strongest Middle Eastern ally, while also working strategically with Saudi Arabia to contain Iran. Any Republican nominee will oppose unrestricted late-term abortions, and will support conscience clauses and religious liberty rights. They will reject defunding the police in favor of stronger law enforcement, especially against violent criminals and property crimes. They will favor domestic energy and reject environmental extremism that demands top-down control over the economy, unilateral actions that harm America's international competitiveness, and a culture of scarcity. They will push back against mainstream media bias, and will champion free speech in the face of cancel culture. When Republican candidates differ from Trump, they may do so by being more conservative. Trump was more willing than many Republicans to embrace sentencing reform, paid family leave, and government limits on prescription drug pricing. He questioned defense spending increases, and floated transgender rights and gun restrictions before pulling back. Democrats could show they truly opposed Trump, rather than using ad hominem attacks to oppose conservative policies held by tens of millions of their fellow Americans. They could separate the policies from the man, and refrain from demonizing candidates for holding mainstream conservative views. They could try to isolate him by not condemning potential contenders for working in his administration or seeking his endorsement. They could do the hard work of making the case for their policies rather than simply sneering "Trumpism" as an epithet. They have instead chosen expediency over principle, and wonder why Trump remains a political force.

body:
The recent EPA decision makes it that much clearer that we need urgent action by states, and by Congress, to protect Americans’ basic rights—including the right to a livable planet.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=726%2E61531%2EAXd6jU)
Hey, did you see Peter’s email from the other day? This one’s worth a look:
\---- ORIGINAL MESSAGE ----
_From: Peter Welch_
_Sent: July 21, 2022_

Hello,
At the end of its term, the Supreme Court issued their ruling in _West Virginia v. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)_ , which essentially guts the authority of the EPA to mandate carbon emissions reductions.
Here’s why that’s a big deal: The EPA’s ability to force electricity generators to shift to cleaner options is a key tool for the federal government to keep our environment safe and to reduce carbon pollution. Once again, the conservative Supreme Court has dealt a blow to the critical work of our government, the health of all Americans, and the safety of our planet for future generations.
**I refuse to let this ruling deter us in our fight to address the climate crisis. Congress must take action—now.[ So I’m asking: Will you chip in $5 or anything you can to build a movement for a Green New Deal and urgent climate action?](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3600?t=3&akid=726%2E61531%2EAXd6jU)**
[CHIP IN ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3600?t=8&t=9&akid=726%2E61531%2EAXd6jU)
---
Every American—no matter who they voted for—has benefited from the EPA’s work to ensure clean air, safe drinking water, and a sustainable planet. Make no mistake: the Court hasn’t simply ruled against the EPA. They’ve ruled in favor of corporate polluters over the public good.
**The Court is putting Americans in danger. It’s outrageous. It’s disappointing. But it’s also unsurprising.**
The Supreme Court is no longer a non-partisan arbiter. It has been carved into an intensely conservative body, working on behalf of an extreme right-wing agenda, against the will of the American people. **This decision makes it that much clearer that we need urgent action by states, and by Congress, to protect Americans’ basic rights—including the right to a livable planet.**
[**A contribution from you today would send a powerful message that we’re nowhere near done fighting. Please chip in to help fight corporate polluters and pass a Green New Deal.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3600?t=4&akid=726%2E61531%2EAXd6jU)
**There’s no doubt about it: if we continue on this path, marginalized communities will suffer the most damage.** A Green New Deal will reduce greenhouse gas emissions and help us avoid the worst consequences of climate change while also tackling economic inequality and racial injustice. That’s why I was proud to be an original cosponsor of the Green New Deal alongside Senator Bernie Sanders and Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
I’ve brought members of Congress together to deliver results before—even against powerful interests like fossil fuel corporations. From leading climate and green energy legislation in the House, to joining climate marches with environmental leaders, climate action has been a cause near and dear to me for decades. And I don’t intend to slow down as senator: I’ll continue working towards a more just and sustainable future that advances clean energy, while creating good-paying and equitable green jobs.
**We can still create a future where future generations thrive. But only if we work together.**
[**Chip in anything you can to help us build a movement for a Green New Deal and meaningful climate action that can stand up to even the highest court in the land.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3600?t=5&akid=726%2E61531%2EAXd6jU)
Thanks for making this possible,
Peter

Friend --

**By striking down _Roe v. Wade_ , the conservatives on the U.S. Supreme Court signaled their intent to give extreme Republican state legislatures significantly more power over fundamental rights to privacy.** And in an upcoming case -- _Caster v. Merrill_ \-- the Court’s conservatives could allow state legislatures to adopt maps that dilute the voting power of voters of color.

That means Republican state legislators could roll back even more fundamental rights -- and their own constituents might not be able to stop them.

_Caster v. Merrill_ is part of a decades-long campaign by conservatives to roll back the landmark Voting Rights Act (VRA). During my presidency, the Court’s conservatives chipped away at the VRA’s requirements for states with a history of discriminatory voting practices. In this latest case, they could do something similar nationwide.

[**The through-line here is clear: Conservatives on the Supreme Court are looking to roll back hard-won rights by declaring that those rights can be subject to the whims of gerrymandered state legislatures. They did it by overturning _Roe_ , and they may do it again by further undermining the Voting Rights Act. _Merrill_ isn’t the only pending Supreme Court case that could give state legislatures more power to gerrymander districts. The Court is also hearing a case called _Moore v. This will be the most important race in the entire country...Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5268c966b0784e13bd1f64b6eaca4fb9&_e=le43YqLoGR6n0oXeoMPEaR15rAEnjy1j2FnQSHeM_IZQGKHh6Bi98yr_-LYRhOSQdfwS7TBlO3sekxvO2K3S-d2oY9tv0NzamihRZFL-Sr76ANNxn_issruO7rKA5s2PLFUIp7CbGYZH6Pf5QesTx-zIX87gsNyV6B0Hpmy6f-pqSwPuYJiSBLzWNE5wJRw1Yp6-yHtPkDvwn4WhS0hBGPNONL1eiokzqwms5wuFMCAzdejF--ZI0Urkf5vUhYAyzx-yQxQoH5RBUB0Xw8WytG5jDVmFm8gBKyZoZDgBDZUGNIEMGGHNhgm1BUtUH1Otw4nkJrGK0eN70aog3b7tzWZ5AbjMfDmONq7JHDcec7P-6LZjmvSr52gQ-l24leBrn5hH3H1wPHEq16VzU026jZxOV_nKCl9E1iAoy1o510CspT60R5wDxZx2hP7B9NJe6fijceu7X0VwUgd9dS7FZUrutpNpQPk6-_-FK97xuxA%3D)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5268c966b0784e13bd1f64b6eaca4fb9&_e=le43YqLoGR6n0oXeoMPEaR15rAEnjy1j2FnQSHeM_IZQGKHh6Bi98yr_-LYRhOSQdfwS7TBlO3sekxvO2K3S-d2oY9tv0NzamihRZFL-Sr76ANNxn_issruO7rKA5s2PLFUIp7CbGYZH6Pf5QesTx-zIX87gsNyV6B0Hpmy6f-pqSwPuYJiSBLzWNE5wJRw1Yp6-yHtPkDvwn4WhS0hBGPNONL1eiokzqwms5wuFMCAzdejF--ZI0Urkf5vUhYAyosy5eklx-DPKyM_QgVw9BOCHjz70CFKv62EsX91dU12YxtsIm1ArdOGbbxqJTXn7-U_7TgZdCDCDEowem4fpneztvvlX4uaZswulAVJYHYTQjUSF0sfZykIalr0aAPMJXzB4ksVLOFwkzuB9XrqUED7P2QDZJHVFpWSI9icCrez7er4TTGpwDlYWarOqdn8HCCr-2SJwKGqbF_VJWl3W3gpkHskQo5nvGdi8GCTbpoo%3D)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

I can't believe my eyes, friend! After MONTHS of trailing her Trump-backed opponent, Catherine Cortez Masto (D-NV) is GAINING GROUND in the race that WILL decide Senate control: **Polling shows her just 1 POINT DOWN!** [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19652?t=7&akid=3883%2E878179%2E3J3NT3) Take it from someone who's been in politics for decades: You should be SO DAMN EXCITED about the state of this race. Now is the best opportunity to make a grassroots donation that will help Catherine pull ahead. [So please, will you split a $5 donation between Catherine's campaign and Voter Protection Project right now to keep Nevada's Senate seat blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19652?t=8&akid=3883%2E878179%2E3J3NT3) A polling shift of this magnitude doesn't happen every day, and friend, it's exactly the movement we need to see when it comes to protecting our Democratic Senate majority!!!

**But the BAD NEWS is that immediately after this poll showed Catherine SURGING, Donald Trump came to Nevada to hold a rally for her opponent and STOP all our momentum.**

I gotta be honest, seeing Trump standing on that stage, viciously attacking Catherine, ENRAGED me. I’ve had a front-row seat observing the rise of strong, trailblazing women in American politics, and Cheri Beasley is absolutely one of them.
#

When I was President of Planned Parenthood, I saw firsthand how far extreme right-wing politicians were willing to go to roll back our rights. I warned for years about their plan not just to overturn _Roe_ , but if given the chance, to pass a national abortion ban.
Sadly, that is the reality we’re facing right now with Senate candidates like Ted Budd in North Carolina, who has said he supports a total ban on abortion without exceptions — not even for rape, incest or the health of the mother.
Republican insiders like Ted Budd want folks like you and me to sit down, shut up and do nothing as Washington Republicans roll back our constitutional rights. They want us to believe that we cannot fight back – or march forward – because they know that they are no match for the power of the people if we act together.
It’s our job to prove them wrong — to show them that we’re not giving up or throwing in the towel. And the best way for us to do that right now is to show up to support Cheri Beasley.
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to help Cheri Beasley defeat her radical opponent Ted Budd and flip North Carolina? This is one of the most competitive races anywhere in the country — perhaps our best chance to expand the majority.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-july22.kbaN_T&refcode=em220728-2-MA&t=1&akid=1331%2E357359%2EGihRRk)

Look, this race isn’t just about stopping someone who wants to completely ban abortion. It’s also a real opportunity to send an inspiring champion for the people to the United States Senate – someone who will do what’s right no matter the politics and put people first.
I’ve had a front-row seat observing the rise of strong, trailblazing women in American politics, and Cheri Beasley is absolutely one of them.
Cheri’s voice is desperately needed in the U.S. Senate. As a former judge and the first Black woman to serve as North Carolina’s Chief Justice, she brings an important perspective to the table and understands firsthand that abortion is a constitutional right.
Cheri will not surrender or back down from a tough fight. While Republican legislatures try to ban abortion, she’ll fight to codify abortion rights nationwide.
[**I’m personally asking you to contribute $3 or any amount you can today to help Cheri flip North Carolina. If we win here, we have a real path to ending the filibuster and passing legislation to protect the right to abortion in every single state.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-july22.kbaN_T&refcode=em220728-2-MA&t=3&akid=1331%2E357359%2EGihRRk)

| | | Dear friend,
---
On Tuesday, we cast our ballots in **one of the most important primaries in the country.** We know how important it is because we live here, in the beautiful Pacific Northwest--and we know it's worth defending from the left and the corrupt establishment. Well, guess who else knows it? **Our favorite President, Donald J. Trump.** On Monday evening, [President Trump and I did a tele-rally together](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/T2cyEvvCRV27SOKML5pTZA/OSsg9oa892Ah1ZmSC92XpuCQ) to talk about how the America First movement can restore the land we love, from Washington's 3rd congressional district to the four corners of our nation. **He called WA-3 "one of the most important races in America" because he knows that you and I are the tip of the spear for the America First movement.** He didn't just endorse me in the primary. President Trump reiterated why I'm the right candidate to defeat RINO Republican Jaime Herrera Beutler:
* I'll fight inflation and the socialist agenda
* I'll stop the southern border invasion
* I'm pro-life and pro law and order
* I will defend parental rights in education and vote to ban Critical Race Theory in schools.
* I'll fix our broken and corrupt election systems

I'm humbled by President Trump's support, and I'm ready to fight harder than ever before against the D.C. uniparty who want to destroy the freedoms that We the People have won. By the way...here's what President Trump said about my opponent, Jaime Herrera Beutler:
* She doesn't fight for our state
* She's a RINO
* She's not respected in Congress
* She works for the Swamp
* She's best friends with turncoats Liz Cheney and Adam Kinzinger

[**HELP JOE DRAIN THE SWAMP**](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/dK3s34AqiH87wP894TNXVg/OSsg9oa892Ah1ZmSC92XpuCQ) Those of you who have followed my primary-and **especially those who are already early voting** and telling their friends and family-know that President Trump is right about Jaime Herrera Beutler's disastrous record. We've got to win this race and stop her from pretending she represents us. As long as I've known President Trump, I've appreciated his compassion and support. Many of you know that he was the first to encourage me to run for Congress after my wife was killed fighting ISIS in Syria. Since 2016, we've all owed President Trump a debt of gratitude for everything he did to halt the advance of the left and lead our nation back to greatness. Now, I owe him even more for doing this rally and giving me his complete and total endorsement once again right as we cross the finish line. Despite millions in dark money working against me from the establishment, on Tuesday, we'll win as a team. Please help us as we make our final push in the coming days. Together toward victory.

### UPCOMING EVENTS
## I want to meet you!
We're outworking every other campaign, and unlike Jaime Herrera Beutler, we're meeting with the voters face to face to hear their concerns and answer the tough questions. That's why we're hosting a town hall every day from now up until election day on August 2nd.

#
Peter, with just days before her primary, Cori needs our help. This is what she’s up against:
* Her opponent loaned his own campaign a whopping $135,000, allowing him to run a blitz of TV ads in St. Louis
* A company tied to her opponent’s dad is funding a PAC running attack ads against Cori
* The 20+ year corporate incumbent that Cori defeated is supporting her opponent

Cori’s opponent has a lot of big money and corporate Democrats behind him. We cannot let the Democratic establishment undo the progress we’ve made and defeat Cori next week.
[Rush a split contribution to Cori and Justice Democrats right now to fuel Cori’s primary campaign. We MUST re-elect Cori and we must send her grassroots support today.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112463?refcode=em20220728-24482&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=24482%2E1203867%2Ee_e6sM)

Friend,

I want to tell you an important story today, but before I do: [**Would you consider donating to my campaign for U.S. Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48462261/358334400/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3885-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODAxNGVmZi1jODBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=svNE8KVx57u5ZIt94p6UW2bPwL8XjMn1InP1GtabqIM=) As a young girl, I could never have imagined that I'd become a congresswoman and one day run for U.S. Senate, but my parents believed in me and did everything they could to ensure I had a bright future. I'd be so honored to have your support, too.
**Now, let me tell you a story:** I remember in seventh grade, my class was going on a big trip to Washington, D.C. My dad, a janitor who worked seven days a week to make ends meet for our family, asked for an advance to pay for my plane ticket. I'm still amazed today he could find the money – and I'm touched that he sacrificed so much for me.
That first trip to Washington, D.C., made a major impact on me. I stood at the feet of Lincoln's statue in the Lincoln Memorial, gazing up at this giant of American history. I walked through the Library of Congress with wide eyes. I looked at the U.S. Capitol in awe, totally unaware that one day I'd have the opportunity to work in that very building.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48462263/358334402/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3885-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODAxNGVmZi1jODBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=svNE8KVx57u5ZIt94p6UW2bPwL8XjMn1InP1GtabqIM=)
If my parents could see me today, they would be so proud of everything I've been able to accomplish. I truly believe that only in America can a little Black girl growing up in the South in the 1960s have such an amazing story of opportunity.
But the truth is, my story is a rare one. For so many working families like mine, the American dream is simply out of reach. That's why I'm running for U.S. Senate to expand my story of opportunity to more Americans – by reducing student debt, raising the minimum wage, expanding access to childcare and cutting health care costs.
If you're with me, I need your support right now. I'm neck and neck with Marco Rubio in this close race. If we flip Florida blue, Democrats could expand our Senate majority and pass our agenda, so I have to ask: **[Will you donate $5 right now to help me surge ahead, win this race and provide more opportunities for working families?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48462265/358334404/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3885-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODAxNGVmZi1jODBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=svNE8KVx57u5ZIt94p6UW2bPwL8XjMn1InP1GtabqIM=)**
Thanks for being part of this historic grassroots movement.

Congresswoman Val Demings

We’re on the verge of a _major_ climate and economic deal in the Senate, folks. _The New York Times_ is calling it the “most ambitious action ever taken by the United States” in the fight to take on climate change. The _Inflation Reduction Act_ is exactly what this moment calls for —**lowering everyday costs for Americans _today_ and protecting the planet for our children and the generations of _tomorrow_ at the same time.** The media is calling this a “surprise” deal. But it didn’t happen out of nowhere. I’ve been fighting to pass climate policy since I first got into politics on the Albuquerque City Council in 2004. And in recent months Senate Democrats and Majority Leader Chuck Schumer have pushed hard to reach a deal that addresses inflation, cuts energy costs for families, curbs carbon emissions, lowers prescription drug costs, expands access to affordable healthcare, and more. We’re _so close_ to taking once-in-a-generation action to combat climate change. And this never would have happened without you. Now, we have to keep this momentum going to make sure this gets across the finish line. **Can you chip in $10 or any amount to power our movement? The New York Times is calling it the “most ambitious action ever taken by the United States” in the fight to take on climate change. The Inflation Reduction Act is exactly what this moment calls for —lowering everyday costs for Americans today and protecting the planet for our children and the generations of tomorrow at the same time. The media is calling this a “surprise” deal. But it didn’t happen out of nowhere. I’ve been fighting to pass climate policy since I first got into politics on the Albuquerque City Council in 2004. And in recent months Senate Democrats and Majority Leader Chuck Schumer have pushed hard to reach a deal that addresses inflation, cuts energy costs for families, curbs carbon emissions, lowers prescription drug costs, expands access to affordable healthcare, and more. We’re so close to taking once-in-a-generation action to combat climate change. And this never would have happened without you. Now, we have to keep this momentum going to make sure this gets across the finish line. Can you chip in $10 or any amount to power our movement? | | | Hi Friend, Exciting news from the campaign trail today! Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon announced today that he voted for Tanya in the Republican primary for Arizona’s 4th Congressional District.

_“As a U.S. Congressman, I represented most of Arizona’s new 4th Congressional District and that’s why it is very important to me that the person who wins this primary will have my former constituents’ best interests at heart and fight for them every day in Congress. I decided to vote for Tanya Contreras Wheeless because I know she will do just that.”_ **said Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon.**

_“Tanya has already shown that she can weather attacks from Democrats and rise above them. She is the only one who can beat Democrat incumbent Greg Stanton. That’s why the Democrats are already attacking her and why this primary is so important. I encourage others to join me in voting for Tanya Contreras Wheeless. She is my pick to carry on the tradition of conservative leadership in the East Valley.”_

More about Tanya:

**_Tanya Contreras Wheeless_** launched her campaign for U.S. Congress in August 2021. She is a proven leader with a track record of bringing people together to solve problems. Her vast professional experience includes lawyer, business association CEO, sports executive with the Phoenix Suns, small business owner, and community advocate.

A valley native, she was born to teen parents and is the granddaughter of immigrants. She grew up in a working-class family that often struggled, but despite the challenges, she learned the importance of faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility.

Driven by her desire to create a better life for herself, Tanya worked from the time she was 14. She put herself through Arizona State University, becoming the first person in her family to graduate from college. She went on to graduate from ASU Law with distinction, earning a job at one of the nation’s top law firms.

Now, Tanya is ready to bring her experience and thoughtful leadership to Congress. She believes in the promise of the American dream and will fight to preserve it. She will embrace policies that empower people, not the government. And, she will always put Arizona first.

Tanya lives in Tempe with her husband Steve, an attorney and former F-16 pilot in the U.S. Air Force. They have three wonderful children and two dogs who keep them on their toes.

Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon announced today that he voted for Tanya in the Republican primary for Arizona’s 4th Congressional District. “As a U.S. Congressman, I represented most of Arizona’s new 4th Congressional District and that’s why it is very important to me that the person who wins this primary will have my former constituents’ best interests at heart and fight for them every day in Congress. I decided to vote for Tanya Contreras Wheeless because I know she will do just that.” said Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon. “Tanya has already shown that she can weather attacks from Democrats and rise above them. She is the only one who can beat Democrat incumbent Greg Stanton. That’s why the Democrats are already attacking her and why this primary is so important. I encourage others to join me in voting for Tanya Contreras Wheeless. She is my pick to carry on the tradition of conservative leadership in the East Valley.” | | We are poised to finish strong and thank you for all of your support! Best, Team Tanya | \-- More about Tanya: Tanya Contreras Wheeless launched her campaign for U.S. Congress in August 2021. Her vast professional experience includes lawyer, business association CEO, sports executive with the Phoenix Suns, small business owner, and community advocate. A valley native, she was born to teen parents and is the granddaughter of immigrants. She grew up in a working-class family that often struggled, but despite the challenges, she learned the importance of faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility. Driven by her desire to create a better life for herself, Tanya worked from the time she was 14. She put herself through Arizona State University, becoming the first person in her family to graduate from college. She believes in the promise of the American dream and will fight to preserve it. She will embrace policies that empower people, not the government. And, she will always put Arizona first. Alexandria’s amendment would tackle the war on drugs and advance MDMA and psilocybin for therapeutic applications.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220728-3254-header&t=1&akid=3254%2E2526796%2ECKKkrf)
It took three years, but Alexandria’s amendment to study MDMA and psychedelic substances for therapeutic applications _finally_ passed the House.
Why is this important? There’s a lot of evidence that these drugs can help veterans address PTSD, and they are far less addictive than many prescription opioids. Yet, the stigma around these drugs have stopped scientific study. Now, with this amendment, that will change.
[Tackling the war on drugs, and fighting for science over stigma is one of the many reasons we need to keep Alexandria in Congress. Can you chip in $3 today to help reelect her?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220728.R26rAb&refcode=em20220728-3254-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3254%2E2526796%2ECKKkrf)

Getting this amendment passed was a rare bipartisan win.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220728.R26rAb&refcode=em20220728-3254-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3254%2E2526796%2ECKKkrf)

Election Day is less than four months away, and the stakes couldn’t be higher. The future of the country will be determined on November 8.
_Will Democrats maintain control? Will Republicans win and put America back on the right path?_** ** There are so many questions, and the answers are up to us. If we put in the hard work between now and Election Day, we CAN win. We CAN make the difference between victory and defeat. ** **_Are you with me?_** ** Make no mistake: It won’t be easy. There will be ups and downs. There will be tough days on the campaign trail. But nothing worth having ever comes easily. ** ** Friend, let’s band together and support Republicans across the country. clean_body: | | | Friend, Election Day is less than four months away, and the stakes couldn’t be higher. The future of the country will be determined on November 8. Will Democrats maintain control? Will Republicans win and put America back on the right path? There are so many questions, and the answers are up to us. If we put in the hard work between now and Election Day, we CAN win. We CAN make the difference between victory and defeat. Are you with me? Make no mistake: It won’t be easy. There will be ups and downs. There will be tough days on the campaign trail. But nothing worth having ever comes easily. Friend, let’s band together and support Republicans across the country. Support can come in many forms: volunteering, educating your friends and family, and so much more. Support can also come in the form of a donation, which is why I’m reaching out to you today I’m sad to say, great Republican candidates are falling behind their liberal opponents in fundraising. Democrats are outraising and outspending Republicans, and we can’t keep up. It’s up to you and me to help close the fundraising gap as much as we can. We’re going to get Republicans elected to office — no ifs, ands, or buts. America depends on it. contribution will make or break Republicans’ ability to pull ahead and secure the necessary resources to win back the Senate and House majorities. There’s so much on the line. name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Matt Gaetz took the attack on abortion care in a new, sleazy direction, insulting the looks of women campaigning for this important health care right. Will you show him that you have women’s backs?
body:
Answer Matt Gaetz by supporting abortion care
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, you have to wonder if Matt Gaetz had his conscience surgically removed on purpose. **_“Although your intentions were hateful, your public shaming of my appearance has done nothing but benefit me.”_** Those were the words of the incredibly brave Olivia Julianna in response to attacks on her and other pro-choice women by alleged sex traficker, Rep. Matt Gaetz of Florida.
If you sat down to construct the most awful human being you could, combined the seven deadly sins and every bad quality we know to exist, you'd be left with Matt Gaetz. Gaetz, who as we said is being actively investigated by the Justice Department for sex trafficking, shocked nobody when he was one of 20 Republican House members to vote against re-authorizing an anti-sex trafficking law. **Ever the sniveling cretin, Gaetz also got up at a right-wing conference and said, "Why is it that women with the least likelihood of getting pregnant are the ones most worried about having abortions." The crowd for his oh so witty remark--11 yr old boys in locker rooms--were not there to respond. ** **But Julianna was. ** **This courageous 19 year old abortion rights activist in Miami, Fl, was having none of that. In what can only be called an inspiring response--after reminding him he's an "alleged pedophile" and a "small man,"\--[she went ahead and raised $460,000 for ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc039d265-5dd6-46f0-a621-7a169b026cd3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[_Gen Z For Choice Abortion Fund_ , an organization that splits funds between the 50 states to ensure as many women as possible, who can't afford it or life in red states that have banned their basic rights, don't lose their right to choose. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0621d35c-2bab-4fb8-9017-9c7cc6c49b95/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

---
| Well, as much as Gaetz repelled us, Julianna inspired us too. It is acts of heroism and defiance like this, by 19 year olds no less, that will be the reason we defeat these aspiring fascists and the regressive policies they support. [**So will you join me in honor of Julianna, women across the country, and, as a big middle finger to Matt Gaetz, in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Gen Z For Change, so we can help women across the country continue to control of their lives?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta72f6959-debf-4aee-bd08-f90067d9f772/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you as always for all you do to fight for equality in our country. Cliff

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**BREAKING: Kevin Hayslett Statistically Tied with Anna Paulina Luna in Republican Primary for FL-13**
_Momentum Shifts to Hayslett as his Trump Tough Republican Message Resonates With Voters_
**Clearwater, FL** \- A recent poll of likely Republican primary voters in Florida’s 13th Congressional District shows Kevin Hayslett statistically tied with Anna Paulina Luna. The poll shows former prosecutor Kevin Hayslett receiving 34% of the primary vote, Luna receiving 36%, and Amanda Makki in a distant third place with 9%.

The poll, which was conducted by American Viewpoint from July 24-27, 2022, surveyed 400 likely Republican primary voters across Florida’s 13th Congressional District. The margin of error was plus or minus 4.9%.

The recent survey findings show Hayslett rapidly building momentum and solidifying support as voters learn more about his Trump Tough record as a former prosecutor who [“Faced Down”](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=639407c0aa&e=c927abcf3e) and prosecuted human traffickers and drug cartels.
* Between a late June internal poll and today, Hayslett’s favorable to unfavorable ratio has gone from 31:6 to 51:21. Luna’s image has gone from 57:15 to 57:28 and Makki’s has gone from 39:9 to 39:16.
* Among those who have an opinion on both Hayslett and Luna (65% of the electorate), Hayslett leads 41%-36% underscoring that Hayslett should be able to build a lead the more defined he becomes.

American Viewpoint’s polling memo and survey findings can be viewed [HERE](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=fd4200bf2e&e=c927abcf3e).

As a political outsider and first time candidate, Hayslett has skyrocketed to frontrunner status in the FL-13 Republican primary, [raising](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=a827c204bf&e=c927abcf3e) close to $1.2 million in under six months and compiling more cash-on-hand than any of his opponents. The poll shows that there is a clear appetite for an outsider candidate who has what it takes to flip FL-13 red come November.

“Hayslett’s tough-on-crime record and his overwhelming support from law enforcement has proven to voters that he is the only Trump Tough Republican ready to take on Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi,” stated his consultant, Sam Oh. “This type of movement and shift to a first time candidate is unprecedented, and it’s clear - Kevin Hayslett’s message is resonating with voters and he has what it takes to win this seat.” # # #

And to Voter Protection Project, too.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19819?t=7&akid=3887%2E878179%2EyBagZ1) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Riley and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19820?t=8&akid=3887%2E878179%2EyBagZ1)

Who? Glad you asked. Josh was my General Counsel on the Senate Judiciary Committee from 2011 - 2014, and is now running for an open House seat in upstate New York. Even during a period of partisan gridlock, Josh and I successfully got two bills through Congress and signed by the President. One created new rights for survivors of domestic violence. The other provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs.

Josh grew up in Upstate New York in a working-class family. His entire career has been dedicated to making life better for people who don't have people fighting for them. Get to know Josh and what he stands for [**HERE**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19824?t=13&akid=3887%2E878179%2EyBagZ1). I was fortunate to have had many, many brilliant, dedicated staffers during my years in the Senate. None was better than Josh. And I can't think of one who would make a more effective member of Congress.

More often than not, I was the best prepared member of the Judiciary Committee. That's because I took my work very seriously and so did Josh. That said, we had fun. Please go to his [**website**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19824?t=14&akid=3887%2E878179%2EyBagZ1) to get to know Josh and what he believes and will be fighting for.

Josh's seat is a new one, created during redistricting. In a year where every seat will count, this is a tossup district that is a MUST-win for Democrats.

Thanks for your attention.

Al

**P.S.** No other former staff member of mine is running for Congress. So, this is the last one of these!

This Sunday, July 31 at 8 PM ET/7 PM CT, we’ll be speaking with Mandela about his priorities and his plan to win at the WFP July Assembly. WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell will speak with Mandela about his vision for our country and answer questions submitted by WFP supporters like you. The Working Families Party Assembly is our monthly virtual gathering where we recommit ourselves to each other and the movement. We’ll talk about the biggest problems we're facing, share our priorities, and get concrete about how we are building the power we need to secure the future we want. During this assembly, you'll get to know Mandela. You’ll hear how he’ll fight to tackle gun violence, defend abortion rights, and build communities where we can all thrive. All attendees are invited to submit a question online, which may be answered by Mandela live during the Assembly. Hi Peter,

In January 1973, when the Supreme Court handed down the _Roe V. Wade_ ruling, it was a snowy day in New York. I was a college student headed to Albany to convince lawmakers that New York’s law decriminalizing abortion – which had passed in 1970 – should be preserved. **That’s how long the fight for our reproductive rights has moved me to action.**

Fast forward to today, when that fight is front and center again. That’s why my priority now is electing Josh Riley to Congress.

I trust Josh to carry this fight to Washington, so I’m doing all I can to help Josh win. [_**Will you join me in this fight?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48452748/358319604/1712918886?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20220728-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTljZWY0Mi1iZDBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VjFu_IlXfeJMNqfOrBBh0rZYlfRepc6l-dSXs4Rw5cQ=)

[_**Josh’s team is just $15,000 away from their goal. Can you pitch in $5, $10, or more to help get them over the top?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48452750/358319605/1712918886?refcode=BLU-JRFC-20220728-1-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTljZWY0Mi1iZDBlLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VjFu_IlXfeJMNqfOrBBh0rZYlfRepc6l-dSXs4Rw5cQ=)

I have to tell you, Peter, our reproductive rights are in pretty good shape in New York State. **The big fight now is in Congress – where we’ll really need Josh’s experience and skills. He knows D.C., and he also knows us.**

But winning this race won’t be easy. Trust me, as someone who’s been a candidate for Congress; it takes a lot of hard work to turn out the vote.

We can’t afford to hope our Congressperson has the tools to win the fight for our reproductive rights. Josh must be our Democratic nominee, so we need your help.

The old rule of thumb is that every dollar in the door helps reach one more voter. [_**So, Peter, this is crunch time. I’m doing all I can to help Josh win, but I need you to do the same. clean_body: Josh must be our Democratic nominee, so we need your help. | = | = Hi Peter, In January 1973, when the Supreme Court handed down the Roe V. Wade ruling, it was a snowy day in New York. I was a college student headed to Albany to convince lawmakers that New York’s law decriminalizing abortion – which had passed in 1970 – should be preserved. That’s how long the fight for our reproductive rights has moved me to action. Fast forward to today, when that fight is front and center again. That’s why my priority now is electing Josh Riley to Congress. I trust Josh to carry this fight to Washington, so I’m doing all I can to help Josh win. = This week marks Josh Riley’s FINAL end-of-month fundraising deadline before the August election, and it’s all-hands-on-deck. = I have to tell you, Peter, our reproductive rights are in pretty good shape in New York State. The Inflation Reduction Act is a breakthrough.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/20220728_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&t=2&akid=13082%2E53494%2ErWnoqD) Friend, this is a breakthrough. Last night in a surprise move, Senator Joe Manchin and Senator Chuck Schumer unveiled the Inflation Reduction Act, a reconciliation deal that will be the **single largest investment in clean energy in American history** and put the U.S. on a path to reduce pollution by 40 percent by 2030 — _if we help it overcome the remaining hurdles on its way to President Biden's desk._ [**_This is the moment we've been working toward, Friend. Call your members of Congress now to tell them you're counting on them to pass this historic bill!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/20220728_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&t=3&akid=13082%2E53494%2ErWnoqD) | [CALL NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/20220728_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&t=4&akid=13082%2E53494%2ErWnoqD)
---
The Inflation Reduction Act allocates $369 billion for climate and energy investments, including:
* Clean energy tax credits for wind and solar, EVs, efficiency upgrades, heat pumps, and much more
* More than $60 billion for environmental justice priorities
* Up to $60 billion for domestic clean energy manufacturing
* $27 billion for a Clean Energy Accelerator
* And much, much more!

The text does include some giveaways to the fossil fuel industry — it mandates four offshore lease sales (two in the Gulf of Mexico and one in Alaska), and, astoundingly, ties any future offshore wind or wind power on public lands to oil and gas lease sales. These pieces simply don't make sense in a climate bill — but they are a reflection of the makeup of the U.S. Senate — something we must keep working on.
**Ultimately, this bill is essential for meeting our climate targets. This would be the single largest investment in clean energy in American history. It can't wait another moment.** [**_Call your representatives and urge them to pass the Inflation Reduction Act as soon as possible. We've got a script if you need it._**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/20220728_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-07-28_inflation_reduction_act_&t=5&akid=13082%2E53494%2ErWnoqD)
The American people elected Democrats to get a climate bill done, and now they must come through. It's up to us to keep the pressure on until President Biden signs these historic climate investments into law.
Onward,
Jamal Raad
Executive Director, Evergreen Action

clean_body: My first election made history | = This is personal for me, Peter — my first election made history as I became the first openly queer, Black woman elected in Florida at any level. That’s why I’m humbled to announce this endorsement: = As a queer Black woman, I understand firsthand the destructive toll of anti-gay discrimination and hate. I’m in this fight not just to make history as a Black queer woman, but to make a difference for the people of Florida. With less than a month until our must-win primary for State House, I need all hands on deck to continue this fight as the only Black queer representative in Florida. = | = I am more determined than ever to protect the LGBTQ+ community of Florida, and I am proud to have the support of the Florida LGBTQ+ Democratic Caucus. But we can’t continue making history without you, Peter — I need your support. Peter,

**A new poll from Georgia's largest newspaper shows that Senator Warnock holds a lead of 3 points over our campaign.**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Van Someren for WI
body:
It’s time to level the playing field and rebuild the middle class | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b6eac3755a4b/i-am-running-for-congress-9138886?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=29183a48aa&e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | Hi there,

Last week Mike rolled out [his plan to Level the Playing Field and Rebuild the Middle Class.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=79b502e264&e=356c0699dd)

**[Tonight he's going Live on Facebook at 7:30 to talk about this plan more in-depth](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=bfa0e68939&e=356c0699dd)** , and how these policies will get America back on a path to being on the cutting edge of new technologies, products, and living standards.

Don't miss out — [join us tonight.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=48508e622c&e=356c0699dd)

Team Van Someren

_[P.S. You can ask Mike a question about this plan to answer during this live event through this link here. ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=ca06495aa4&e=356c0699dd)_
---
|
---
| July 27, 2022

Hi there,

**The middle class in America has been on the decline for over 40 years thanks to economic policies that have enriched the super-wealthy and megacorporations**.

While the super-wealthy expanded their share of the pie through special-interest sweetheart deals, the middle class has become hollowed out. [**Now, it’s time to level the playing field and rebuild the middle class.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=306642416a&e=356c0699dd)

I’ve said time and again throughout this campaign that we need to help the folks putting in an honest days’ work get ahead, while helping those in need get back on their feet again.

[**This is how we do it.**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=cc97924a21&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=fc5a0240a6&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [Read Mike's Full Plan](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=d5e370cb50&e=356c0699dd "Read Mike's Full Plan")
---
| We have a market economy with a number of broken markets. These broken markets have created an economy with higher prices, fewer jobs with family-supporting wages, fewer jobs overall, a distorted media, and tenuous supply chains in a variety of sectors from food to manufactured goods.

Fixing these markets through the policies outlined above will go a long way to actually solving the problems facing everyday Americans and will not just transfer some wealth from the very wealthy to the working poor.

**They will allow Americans to work and get ahead from that work. Better yet, they will put America back on a path to being on the cutting edge of new technologies, products, and living standards.**

The American middle class was the economic engine of the world at one time and it needs to be rebuilt and strengthened. We must ensure that Americans at the bottom of the socioeconomic ladder can get into the middle class, and those in the middle class are secure in that status with little risk of falling out.

Once elected, I’ll do everything in my power to make sure we level the playing field and truly rebuild the middle class.

[Join us for a live discussion on Facebook of these policies July 28, 2022 at 7:30 pm.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=369a83f343&e=356c0699dd) This is your opportunity to ask questions and share thoughts on the economic future of our country. [You can also ask us questions ahead of time through this link](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=6d130c2f13&e=356c0699dd).

Thank you,
Mike

subject: Vaccine mandates leave us vulnerable
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Waltz for Congress
body:
| | | Peter, The National Guard is the backbone of America’s crisis response team.

Whether there’s a national disaster or a domestic crisis, they’re there to rescue our citizens and keep us safe.

_But now, Joe Biden is DECIMATING the national guard with his vaccine mandate - and making us more vulnerable._

**Over 60,000 national guard members aren’t vaccinated, and under the Biden Administration, they’re about to be unjustly kicked out.**

[**Join me today to STAND STRONG against vaccine mandates that put America at risk.**](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=6adca07ff809414b8661c78b2708bd6c&_e=wr-P2MH2xRJtmKYJnYo1nQcY4YjjvnBfJ8tWNi-zk1N4EjChP2qP5hek9csRP8NQpR6CeaXIjeTw_hK6Ycx-PnKL0FlEmbPswhofBLe4Sf0R9n0xaIzFh2nVK_fk4HL9QllkjQK1yPDrW2g__990vtKIzvzu9n0bOprsyeoe-k33KX54dKmblAXDGhKo24Ei1eRuxTfxJ5uG3aKxuE_5n16pSh17N9QVL0mxRDPrqLl5YasX40A9L0IlSBYyEgaKR8MoaY9G4JHyyk2a7KIdSBa0GHwCYMh0j3MYw2asFJtfsfwoePXLSWuHu2hsmEsxIfifBmx2cthEL2jTK6dAt105VMt8Z9rAk0vPzd1RaGsaIqtBuewGSAKRKGpMilJ5NgDhKdfiTmSUvsiDOqXu9A%3D%3D)

[**STAND STRONG >>>**](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=6adca07ff809414b8661c78b2708bd6c&_e=wr-P2MH2xRJtmKYJnYo1nQcY4YjjvnBfJ8tWNi-zk1N4EjChP2qP5hek9csRP8NQpR6CeaXIjeTw_hK6Ycx-PnKL0FlEmbPswhofBLe4Sf0R9n0xaIzFh2nVK_fk4HL9QllkjQK1yPDrW2g__990vtKIzvzu9n0bOprsyeoe-k33KX54dKmblAXDGhKo24EiURPVdh69_LfM0a21bEZFuVUBKrJYv0P4L1d_wCelr9NQwDAomaqx7NZ2QzFLWF9UoIhyj4Uj5Qr7zFq_ZNaAv1bHE5hgdG1SIlMZtyqZiSO2XNHcZ34oCt30F67W9UiJIwiZ9qVBevN5K759oo68EG0TXW1RDZydptFp2eklqbr99qXnHluzWn3n3CTuKowks6yQj3KTl8YpUfifipF6dw%3D%3D)

This is personal to me, Peter.

I’m a National Guard Colonel, and I’ve seen how brave my fellow guard service members are in the face of danger.

**America needs them, regardless of what they choose to put - or not put - in their bodies.**

Vaccine mandates do nothing but punish Americans who chose not to get the jab. And now, the National Guard mandate is hurting citizens _regardless_ of our vaccination mandates by letting our most important domestic force go short staffed.

| | Friends,

I have some unfortunate news to bring you this week. With the GDP numbers coming out today - one thing is clear. [We have now fully entered a recession.](https://PeterLumaj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e4fb4f1b85edd41e1d869424a&id=513f95287c&e=ad1669c4a3) GDP dropping two quarters in a row is the clearest indication of a recession. While the Biden Administration will almost certainly drag their feet on making an official announcement, it's finally been proven what we all have known to be true. The economy is failing, and it's a direct result of the policies pushed by Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and Richard Blumenthal. That's why I am running for Senate - to stop the wasteful tax and spend policies that have been driving our country off a cliff.

And we have been working hard to send Richard Blumenthal packing and bring in the representation that Connecticut needs. I've been knocking a ton of doors, talking to voters, and attending events, like last Thursday's Meet the Candidates in Somers, or Saturday's stops with the Wilton RTC, at the Oxford Car Show, and at the Tolland RTC picnic. Sunday too, we had a great stop at Colchester's Christmas in July event!
---
|
---
| Another exciting campaign development has the been the release of my newest ad this week! Talking about my background, fleeing from communist Albania, and about the damage people like Richard Blumenthal are doing to our economy. If you haven't gotten a chance to see it yet you can watch below!

Peter Lumaj

We need more of this in America.| | | Peter, There was a that stood out to me the other day that I wanted to share with you. It describes the shameful harassment and attacks directed at the women who had bravely came forward to testify to the January 6 Committee about their experiences on that dark day and leading up to it. Shame on those who slink in the shadows and hide in anonymity while attacking the character of these young women. I ask them, have you no decency? These women have taught us a lesson on the need to stand up even when we know how difficult it will be. We need more of this in America. You may have heard that former President Trump was in D.C. this week to give a "policy speech," but as we've come to expect, it was just a dark, divisive political message that offered no real solutions or hope. Watch my remarks on TV about it here: | | The 2024 presidential election is a long way away, but regardless who the candidates end up being, I'm certain that most Americans want leaders who can articulate policy and offer a hopeful, forward-looking vision for America. I know that you agree with me, and that's why it's so important that we continue to speak up and speak out about what we want from our elected leaders. You know that I'm out there every day working on this important mission and I sure appreciate all of the kind donations and supportive words from many of you.
